role: Respiratory Therapist - New Graduate Residency Program - Night Shift
description: Thanks for your interest in Children's Mercy! Do you envision finding a meaningful role with an inclusive and compassionate team? At Children’s Mercy, we believe in making a difference in the lives of all children and shining a light of hope to the patients and families we serve. Our employees make the difference, which is why we have been recognized by U.S. News & World Report as a top pediatric hospital, for eleven consecutive years. Children’s Mercy is in the heart of Kansas City – a metro abounding in cultural experiences, vibrant communities and thriving businesses. This is where our patients and families live, work and play. This is a community that has embraced our hospital and we strive to say thanks by giving back. As a leader in children’s health, we engage in meaningful programs and partnerships throughout the region so that we can improve the lives of children beyond the walls of our hospital. Overview Newly graduated Respiratory Therapists who are graduating Fall 2026, or have graduated in the past with under a year of experience, this opportunity is for you! We are now hiring for our winter cohort, with start dates in February 2027! Get to know our RT team Begin your respiratory therapy career at Children's Mercy Kansas City through our Respiratory Care New Graduate Residency Program. This paid program is designed to support the transition from student to professional practice while developing the clinical knowledge, critical thinking, and confidence needed to care for infants, children, and adolescents with a wide range of respiratory and cardiopulmonary conditions. As a resident, you will be hired as a full-time member of the Respiratory Care Department and participate in a comprehensive onboarding experience that combines hands-on clinical training with structured educational opportunities. Working alongside experienced respiratory therapists, physicians, nurses, advanced practice providers, and other healthcare professionals, residents gain the skills necessary to thrive in a fast-paced pediatric healthcare environment. Residents receive guided clinical training in a variety of specialty areas, including: Neonatal Intensive Care Unit (NICU) Pediatric Intensive Care Unit (PICU) Cardiac Intensive Care Unit (CICU) Medical-Surgical Units The residency incorporates simulation-based learning, case discussions, and classroom education designed to strengthen clinical judgment and pediatric respiratory expertise. In addition to clinical and classroom training, residents are provided structured opportunities for professional growth and support. The program includes regular one-on-one meetings with residency leaders and onboarding specialists to discuss progress, set goals, and address individual learning needs. Residents also participate in facilitated discussions with fellow new graduates, creating dedicated time to reflect on experiences, share challenges and successes, and build a supportive professional community during the transition from student to practitioner. Our goal is to support each therapist's development from novice clinician to a confident, competent pediatric respiratory therapist who is prepared to provide exceptional family-centered care. Applicants are encouraged to apply prior to graduation. Candidates may interview before graduation; however, therapists must obtain all required credentials and state licensure before starting the program. New graduate residency cohorts typically start twice annually, with onboarding occurring in February/March and July/August each year. This program is one of only a handful of residency programs in the country, and the only respiratory care residency program of its kind in the Kansas City metro area. Join a nationally recognized pediatric health system and launch your career with the education, mentorship, and support needed to succeed in pediatric respiratory care. Under the direction of the Medical Director and Director of Respiratory Care each therapist provides safe, proficient, and comprehensive delivery of Respiratory Care services to all ages of patients of Children`s Mercy Hospital. Provides accurate documentation of services performed, provides instruction for students and assists with orientation of new employees. Completes other tasks as assigned. Able to work in a collaborative and multidisciplinary environment. At Children’s Mercy, we are committed to ensuring that everyone feels welcomed within our walls. A successful candidate for this position will join us as we strive to create a workplace that reflects the community we serve, as well as our core values of kindness, curiosity, inclusion, team and integrity. Additionally, it’s important to us that we remain transparent with all potential job candidates. Because we value the safety of the patients and families we serve, as well as the Children’s Mercy staff, we want to let you know that the seasonal influenza vaccine is a condition of employment for all employees in our organization. New employees must be willing to be vaccinated if found non-immune to measles, mumps, rubella (MMR) and chicken pox (varicella) and/or without evidence of tetanus, diphtheria, acellular pertussis (Tdap) vaccination since 2005. If you are selected for this position, you will be asked to supply your immunization records as proof of vaccination. If you and have any concerns about receiving these vaccines, medical and/or religious exemptions can be further discussed with Human Resources. Responsibilities Provides neonatal and pediatric airway management and mechanical ventilation. Provides respiratory treatments, including bronchial hygiene, inflation therapy, inhaled medications. Provides education to patients, families, fellow respiratory therapists and the multidisciplinary team. Provides inhaled medical gas therapy, including oxygen, medical air, blended gases, nitric oxide, nitrogen, heliox, etc. Applies and evaluates non-invasive and invasive monitoring such as pulse oximetry, end-tidal carbon dioxide, transcutaneous carbon dioxide, arterial blood gases, etc. Participates in hospital emergency responses such as code blue, rapid response, trauma, emergency ambulatory response system, etc. Qualifications Associate's Degree Required and No Experience necessary / On-the-Job Training Bachelor's Degree Preferred Licensed Respiratory Therapist MO Registered Respiratory Therapist Licensed Respiratory Therapist KS Employees must obtain Licensed Respiratory Therapist KS or equivalent within 365 days RRT Registered Respiratory Therapist New Graduates have 180 days to obtain the RRT Required Upon Hire American Heart Association BLS Required Upon Hire American Heart Association PALS Required 180 Days Neonatal Resuscitation Program Required 180 Days Benefits at Children's Mercy The benefits plans at Children’s Mercy are one of many reasons we are recognized as one of the best places to work in Kansas City. Our plans are designed to meet the changing needs of our employees and their families. Learn more about Children’s Mercy benefits. Starting Pay Our pay ranges are market competitive. The pay range for this job begins at $29.66/hr, but your offer will be determined based on your education and experience. EEO Employer/Disabled/Vet Children’s Mercy hires individuals based on their job skills, expertise and ability to maintain professional relationships with fellow employees, patients, parents and visitors. A personal interview, formal education and training, previous work experience, references and a criminal background investigation are all factors used to select the best candidates. The hospital does not discriminate against prospective or current employees based on the race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, creed, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, ancestry or veteran status. A drug screen will be performed upon hire. Children’s Mercy is smoke and tobacco free. CM is committed to creating a workforce that supports the diverse backgrounds of our patients and families. We know that our greatest strengths come from the people who make up our team, so we hire great people from a wide variety of backgrounds, not just because it’s the right thing to do, but because it makes our hospital stronger and our patient care more compassionate. If you share our values and our enthusiasm for service, you will find a home at CM. In recruiting for our team, we welcome the unique contributions that you can bring, including education, ideas, culture, and beliefs.

Job Title: Hardware Engineer - Intern Role Overview: The Hardware Engineer Intern assists the responsible Hardware Engineer in the development, fabrication, debugging and documenting of PCBs (Printed Circuit Boards) for high speed applications. This Internship with MACOM will help the Intern to gain valuable work experience in a key discipline, build professional relationships, and take ownership of a business-critical project. During the 12 weeks each Intern will: > Be given an individual and well-defined project with set outcome goals > Gain hands on experience > Receive excellent training and ongoing supervision > Be invited to attend an intern webinar series > Attend networking/social events > Attend and present at Poster Session about each Interns project successes and pitfalls > Receive formal, written feedback The specific responsibilities of the Hardware Engineer Intern may include: 1. PCB Board definition Collect inputs from users of the PCB, including but not limited to, validation engineer, product engineer, IC design engineer etc.; Assist the responsible Hardware Engineer in defining a BRD (Board Requirements Document) that clearly defines what is expected of the board; Review BRD with users and get their sign-off; 2. Schematic Design Create symbols of new components; Consult with designers, application engineers for circuit around the device under test; Component selection and design certain circuits, e.g. Power management circuit, I2C and SPI control circuit; Capture schematic using Mentor’s xDX Designer; 3. Layout Create decals for new components using AutoCAD and Mentor’s PADS. Assist the responsible Hardware Engineer in the layout of the board using Mentor’s PADS; 4. Boards Fabrication Prepare documents for PCB fabrication; Assist the responsible Hardware Engineer in creating costed Bill of Materials; Update the components database as required; 5. Lab Test Verification of power circuits and low speed communication; Debug of the design.

# **About us** B2B payments are a multi-trillion-dollar industry and, as the industry pushes further into digitization and faster settlement, fraud has become a massive problem — to the tune of $43B in annual losses. [Walrus](http://walrusfi.com) is the leader in B2B payment verification, with clients that include some of the biggest names in investment management. Our DoubleCheck platform combines advanced authentication, proprietary technology, AI, and novel UX to collect and confirm payment details. DoubleCheck has defined a new category: verifying the safe transfer of financial information and assets. Walrus is led by PhD computer scientists and security researchers, with decades of experience in engineering, cybersecurity, and cryptography, and many research accomplishments at Harvard, Stanford, MIT, the University of Chicago, Columbia, UTexas, and NYU. We’re backed by one of the world's leading fintech VC funds, as well as founders and former executives of Twitter, Google Maps, Databricks, and Kayak. # **The role** You will be part of the core team at Walrus, working on our [flagship product](https://www.walrusfi.com/doublecheck). You will design, build, and own exciting new modules; examples include payments, reputation, and new kinds of authentication. We are an early-stage company, so you and the team will work together to create standards and culture that will endure for years to come. Of course you’ll get to design and innovate solutions to hard problems, and write a lot of code. But beyond that, as all entrepreneurial software teams do, you’ll be able to design ways of approaching software development. We are looking for people who are thoughtful, not only about software problems, but about how teams work together to solve them, and how people collaborate to build an energizing and supportive workplace. # **About you** You are someone who cares a lot about designing software in a thoughtful way that takes into account bug prevention, testability, and maintainability. You are comfortable with the idea that product design should be data-driven, using evidence rather than opinion. You are: - Experienced with tools for testing. You know that the best software developers demonstrate that their code works, rather than dumping it on a QA department. - Curious, and have an interest in teaching and learning from your colleagues. - A strong written communicator. - Graduating in December 2027, anytime 2028, or spring 2029 with an undergraduate degree in computer science, math, physics, or electrical engineering. # Optionally We strongly encourage you to apply even if you don't meet all the criteria listed; the description is meant to be indicative, not a precise description of a pigeonhole. - You have internship or co-op experience designing, building, and deploying sophisticated web applications. - You have experience with modern UI frameworks, web standards, and web development best practices. - You have a detailed understanding of the design of data models for use in relational databases. - You have used cloud infrastructure to deploy reliable and scalable web applications. - You have built authentication flows and/or implemented secure APIs. - You have built or used tools for data analysis, performance profiling, and debugging. # What it’s like to work with us We’re a tight-knit, early-stage team that’s focused on building a product that our customers love. We have a strong company culture based on collaboration, ownership, and mentoring. We meet sparingly and efficiently. We understand our innate biases and celebrate diversity. We have a low-ego workplace, where we provide the tools for everyone to do their best work. You will work closely with the leadership team, and have room for extensive growth within the company. - This internship will be based at our office in NYC (Financial District). Relocation assistance for the summer will be provided. - For full time permanent employees, Walrus offers competitive compensation and benefits, including salary, equity, paid medical insurance, dental, vision, company contribution to wellness, good coverage for dependents, parental leave, retirement, relocation assistance, and unlimited PTO. We believe talent comes from all backgrounds and walks of life, and are committed to providing a comfortable environment for everyone to work. *This is a temporary internship position with full time hours. The annual base pay for this internship is $77,000 - $113,000 (depending on location and experience). This information is provided per the New York City Human Rights Law.* *Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa at this time.*

Skydio is the leading US drone company and the world leader in autonomous flight, the key technology for the future of drones and aerial mobility. The Skydio team combines deep expertise in artificial intelligence, best-in-class hardware and software product development, operational excellence, and customer obsession to empower a broader, more diverse audience of drone users, from [utility inspectors](https://www.skydio.com/solutions/energy-and-utilities) to [first responders](https://www.skydio.com/solutions/public-safety), [soldiers in battlefield scenarios](https://www.skydio.com/solutions/national-security/tactical-isr), and [beyond](https://www.skydio.com/solutions). **About the Team:** Public safety is where drone technology faces the highest stakes. Agencies across the country are standing up Drone as First Responder (DFR) programs that put an aircraft over an emergency within seconds of a call. As drone programs move from the age of tools to the age of infrastructure, we are expanding our public safety sales team to meet that demand. A major university is a city in miniature: a residential population, often its own dispatch, large events, and a sworn police department responsible for all of it. Campus public safety leaders are under pressure to respond faster to welfare checks and active threats, to manage game days, commencements, and protests safely, and to show students, parents, and trustees that the institution is serious about safety. DFR is becoming a serious answer to that, and this segment is where we prove it. **About the role:** As a Key Account Director, Campus at Skydio, you will lead a national team of Key Account Leaders selling into large universities and colleges with dedicated police departments. This is a first-line leadership role, and the job comes down to three things: recruiting the right people, coaching them into great sellers, and keeping them here. You will not carry your own accounts. Your number is your team's number, and you will hit it by making each person on the team better: sharpening deal strategy, getting into the field on their most competitive pursuits, and building the territory, pipeline, and forecast discipline that makes a segment predictable. You will work alongside peer Directors leading other segments and geographies, and across Channel, Sales Engineering, Business Development, Marketing, Strategic Relationships, Government Relations, and Mission Success. You will run Skydio's public safety playbook, with real autonomy to adapt it where campus is different: a wider buying committee, an academic calendar that dictates when budget moves, and a community that scrutinizes surveillance more closely than most. Knowing which differences warrant a different play is a meaningful part of the job. You will also set the standard for how the team works, not only what it sells. We sell autonomous flying robots and the artificial intelligence that powers them. Every seller here uses AI tools as a normal part of running a territory, and you will model that, coach to it, and hire for it. This is a highly competitive market, and much of the work happens alongside our channel. Your team will sell against incumbent platforms and well-funded challengers, and you will set the standard for how they win. **Location:** Remote, open to candidates anywhere in the United States **How we work** These are the standards we hire to, and as a leader you own them for your segment. You set the bar in who you hire, what you coach to, and what you tolerate. - **High integrity.** Public safety is a tight-knit community. Campus public safety leaders, who benchmark against peer institutions constantly, talk to each other, and a reputation for straight answers travels fast. We sell what the ecosystem is actually capable of, we are clear about where the product is today and where it's headed, and we win on our own merits. There's no compromise here. - **Sales is a team sport.** One team. No lone wolves. Deals are won by account leaders, sales engineering, business development, channel, marketing, strategic relationships, government relations, and mission success pulling in the same direction, and our partners are part of that team, not a channel to be managed around. The best people here care more about the collective number than their own slice of it. - **Great conversationalists.** This is the craft of the job: asking better questions than anyone else in the room, listening for what a chief or a vice president isn't saying, real curiosity about how an institution operates. Not polish, not a rehearsed pitch. Trust in this market is built one honest conversation at a time, and it is the thing competitors cannot copy. - **Curious, and fluent with the tools.** Everyone on this team uses AI as a normal part of their work: researching agencies, preparing for meetings, analyzing pipeline, drafting and then editing. That takes taste more than technical skill: knowing what a quality result looks like, describing a problem precisely enough to get it, and catching the tool when it is confidently wrong. The same muscle makes a great seller. Discovery is specifying the problem; qualification is checking the output. We hire people who are curious about how things work, whether that's an agency's budget, a council's politics, or the aircraft's autonomy, and who have spent the last two years embracing AI rather than waiting to be told to use it. **How you'll make an impact** ### ***Recruit*** - Own hiring for your segment: build a continuous talent pipeline, run a fast and rigorous process, and personally close the candidates you want - Hire to the bar above: integrity, team instinct, conversational craft, and fluency with the tools matter as much as a closed-won history - Screen for evidence, not adjectives: attainment stated year by year with the misses included, deal stories with the mechanics of how the customer bought, and something the candidate has built or changed in how they work in the last two years - Run a structured process: the same core questions for every candidate, a live working session, independent scoring, and a debrief that decides on evidence - Onboard and ramp new Key Account Leaders with a clear path from first day to first award, and hold the ramp accountable ### ***Coach*** - Run 1:1s and deal reviews that build judgment rather than just inspect pipeline - Get in the field: join demos, customer meetings, and executive conversations, then debrief with specific, usable feedback - Coach the competitive game: POV strategy, shaping requirements early, framing Skydio's unique differentiators, displacement plays, and defending accounts under attack - Build MEDDPICC rigor, channel fluency, and forecast honesty into how the team works, not just what they report - Raise the team's fluency with AI tools: build shared workflows for customer research, call prep, RFP response, and pipeline analysis, and hold the line that nothing AI-drafted reaches a customer unreviewed - Coach the institutional sale: getting past the chief to the vice president, general counsel, and risk, and building a case that survives a procurement office and a skeptical campus community ### ***Retain*** - Build a team that people don't want to leave: clear expectations, real development paths, and recognition that lands - Own territory and quota design so assignments are achievable, equitable, and worth staying for - Have honest career conversations early, address disengagement before it becomes a resignation, and be the escalation path your team trusts to clear obstacles ### ***Run the segment*** - Own the segment number: pipeline coverage, forecast accuracy, linearity across the quarter, and the analysis behind them - Partner with Channel on partner strategy, joint planning, and the deal structures that get customers to yes - Act as executive sponsor on your team's largest and most competitive pursuits: present in the room, without taking the deal over - Represent your segment's customer insight, competitive intelligence, and product gaps to Marketing and Product - Tailor the playbook where campus warrants and plan around an academic calendar that concentrates budget and urgency into specific windows - Partner with Channel on cooperative and system-wide contract vehicles **What makes you a good fit** ### ***Required*** - 2+ years leading quota-carrying sellers as a first-line manager, with team attainment you can state year by year, including the year you missed and what you changed - 4+ years total in enterprise software, hardware, or SaaS sales, including personal success closing complex, multi-stakeholder deals - Demonstrated success recruiting sellers: a real network, a clear point of view on what good looks like, a structured process you can describe, and the ability to close candidates - A coaching approach you can articulate, with specific examples of people who got measurably better working for you - Strong voluntary retention history, a record of developing people into larger roles, and the judgment to move quickly when someone isn't right for the seat - Experience selling or leading teams into SLED customers, with working knowledge of procurement vehicles and budget and grant cycles - Fluency selling with and through channel partners - Daily, systematic use of AI tools in your own work, and at least one workflow, analysis, or tool you built or changed in the last two years that made you or your team measurably better (we will ask you to show it, not describe it) - Executive presence with both customer leadership and your own team, and high personal integrity under quota pressure - Ability to travel at least 50% of the time, and based in United States - Experience with higher education or other institutional customers - Good judgment about when to run the standard play and when a segment nuance calls for something different - Obtaining FAA Part 107 certification within the first 60 days of employment is strongly encouraged for all Skydio employees and required for certain positions ### ***Preferred*** - Experience in higher education, or in public safety, specifically law enforcement, fire, or emergency management - Experience building a team from a small base rather than inheriting a mature one - You have built something with AI that other people use, whether a research tool, an analysis, or a team workflow, and you can talk about what the first version got wrong - Curiosity that shows: you can explain how something outside sales works (an agency budget, an airspace waiver, the aircraft's autonomy) in plain language, and you learn fast - Familiarity with MEDDPICC, Salesforce, Clari, BGov, GovWin, Slack, and Google Workspace - UAV, robotics, or emerging technology background, and comfort in a fast-moving environment **What to expect from our process** We run a structured process and we tell you what it is. A 30-minute conversation with the hiring manager. A deep dive on your leadership record: hiring, coaching, retention, and the team number, year by year. A working session where you use your own AI tools on a realistic problem from this segment and walk us through your choices. A panel on the public safety market and how you would run the segment. A conversation about how you think. References with people who worked for you and with you. Every interviewer scores independently against the same rubric before we compare notes. On AI in the process: draft your resume yourself and refine it with AI if you like; we want your real experience, well expressed. Use whatever tools you want to prepare. Expect to use them in the working session. Leave them off during the conversational interviews so we can see how you think in real time. **ABOUT US** With more than 50 years in business, BHHC has grown from a regional organization to a national insurance group, offering insurance products from coast to coast. Relationships are the cornerstone of our culture, and we believe in doing the right thing. That means we invest in our business in every way possible to deliver on our mission and demonstrate that people are what powers our success. Our commitment to financial strength and integrity means our customers can rest assured that we will be there when it counts. At BHHC we embrace diversity and foster an environment where our people can be their authentic selves. Our differences make us stronger and better together, which fosters a harmonious workplace—something we truly value. We’ve created an approachable and collaborative atmosphere. Together, we raise the bar by being curious, remaining customer-focused, and operating with integrity. **BASIC FUNCTION** Upon successful completion of training, the Underwriter 1 will apply basic underwriting concepts and best practices in evaluating new and renewal business in accordance with established guidelines and aide senior members in developing and maintaining agency relationships. This will involve evaluating policy endorsements, executing policy transactions with accuracy, and providing superb customer service. This individual will be expected to continue to build on industry knowledge and accounts will increase in number and complexity. ***ONSITE REQUIREMENT*** ***This is a hybrid opportunity, requiring initial onsite training and, upon successful completion of same, a minimum requirement of three days per work week in our San Francisco, CA office.*** **TEAMWORK RESPONSIBILITIES** Relies primarily on instruction, pre-established guidelines, and judgment to perform the functions of the job and accomplish goals. Performs a variety of tasks directly under the supervision of designated team members as well as autonomously, with proficiency. Works under direct supervision. Possesses strong verbal and written communication skills with internal and external customers and collaboration with peers in an effort to provide the highest level of service. Executes responsibilities professionally and in accordance with the Company’s policies and applicable laws. ### ESSENTIAL RESPONSIBILITIES - Successfully completes the Underwriting training curriculum, introducing workers compensation law, rating and pricing regulations, negotiation techniques, and service standards. - Reviews applications for insurance coverage proficiently, ensuring applicable information is accurate and complete for pricing determination. Works with the Underwriting Support Specialist team to gather appropriate information needed and reaches out to agency partners to request any additional information required. - Analyzes current and prospective policyholders to determine appropriate quotation, indication or declination of policy. Communicates pricing within a predetermined authority level to brokers and producers using industry standards and proprietary software and databases. Ensures profitability and new business goals are met. - Makes prompt, sound decisions on issues that arise in submissions based on the best information available. Properly escalates issues timely to Supervisor. - Coordinates with Underwriting Support Specialists to bind agreed upon policies. Prepares Loss Control requests for appropriate accounts. - Communicates effectively with external clientele and internal resource partners telephonically, via electronic correspondence and if appropriate, in the field. Contributes to productive agency relationships and client retention. Ensures deadlines are met and prompt response is provided. - Accompanies other Underwriters and Marketing Managers to agency visits aimed at learning and promoting improved agency relationships. - Performs special assignments and projects as assigned. ### QUALIFICATIONS - EDUCATION**:** Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university is required. - LANGUAGE ABILITY**:** Able to read, analyze, and interpret general business periodicals, professional journals, technical procedures and governmental regulations. Able to write detailed reports, business correspondence and procedure manuals. Able to effectively present information to management and public groups. - MATH ABILITY**:** Able to work with mathematical concepts such as probability and statistical inference. Able to apply concepts such as addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, fractions, percentages, ratios, and proportions to practical situations. - REASONING ABILITY**:** Able to apply common sense understanding to carry out instructions furnished in written, oral, or diagram form. Able to deal with problems involving several concrete variables in standardized situations. - COMPUTER SKILLS:To perform this job successfully, the individual should be proficient on the Microsoft Office Suite and able to quickly master proprietary and vended software applications.

## About Varda Low Earth orbit is open for business. Varda is accelerating the development of commercial space infrastructure, from in-orbit pharmaceutical processing to reliable and economical reentry capsules. **Varda’s W-Series vehicles are built, designed, and operated by Varda in-house, including the pharmaceutical processing payloads, the capsules, the C-PICA heat shields, and the satellite buses.** From life-saving pharmaceuticals to more powerful fiber optics, there is a world of products used on Earth today that can only be manufactured in space. Varda is accelerating innovation in the orbital economy by creating both the products and infrastructure needed so space can directly benefit life on Earth. Our mission is to expand the economic bounds of humankind. Our team is uniquely suited to accomplishing this goal, with leadership and staff comprised of veterans from SpaceX, Blue Origin, major pharmaceutical companies and Silicon Valley. Varda was founded in January 2021 by Will Bruey and Delian Asparouhov with significant backing from world class investors including Khosla Ventures, Lux Capital, Founders Fund, Caffeinated Capital, General Catalyst, and Also Capital. Varda is headquartered in El Segundo, California, where we have offices and a production facility where our vehicles, equipment, and materials are built, integrated, and tested. Varda also has offices in Washington, DC and Huntsville, AL. Join Varda, and work to create a bustling in-space ecosystem. ## About This Role **Summer internships will range between the months of May and August. All dates dependent upon the university schedule of the selected students. Internships are full-time and on-site in Los Angeles, CA. To be considered for this internship, candidates must be actively enrolled in an accredited undergraduate or graduate degree program.** At Varda, interns are trusted contributors in mission-critical work. As a part of the pharma team, you will work hands-on with our team to support the experimental screening and analysis of small molecule or biologic crystallization. You will gain meaningful experience working at the intersection of pharmaceutical chemistry, materials science, and experimental process design. This internship is best suited for highly motivated students with prior research or lab experience in crystallization. You'll be part of a fast-paced, rigorous environment that values precision, scientific curiosity, and teamwork. Internships at Varda are optimal for students looking to grow technically and professionally while working on impactful projects critical to the company’s success. role: Talent Acquisition Associate (Entry Level / New Grad)
description: [SentiLink](https://www.sentilink.com/) helps institutions and protects customers by accurately resolving identities and flagging fraud risk. Each day, we verify more than 3 million identities, flagging 150k+ fraud attempts in the process. The problems we work on are challenging, and solving them takes deep domain expertise, rigorous analysis, and a willingness to dig into the details. At SentiLink, you'll work alongside smart, highly collaborative colleagues who respect each other's time and judgment, take ownership, and follow through on their commitments. Together, we do truly meaningful work protecting the identities of innocent consumers and flagging the fraudsters attempting to exploit them. We're well capitalized and growing quickly. We already serve 13 of the top 15 U.S. banks, we're expanding into new markets, and we're backed by Craft Ventures, Andreessen Horowitz, NYCA, and Max Levchin. We've been named to the [Forbes Fintech 50](https://www.forbes.com/companies/sentilink/?list=fintech50) and as a [2026 FICO Industry Vanguard Decision Award Winner](https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20260330439998/en/SentiLink-Named-a-2026-FICO-Industry-Vanguard-Decision-Award-Winner-for-Leadership-in-Identity-Theft-Detection). We were also the [first company to go live](https://resources.sentilink.com/blog/sentilink-makes-history-as-first-ecbsv-provider) with the electronic Consent Based Social Security Number Verification (eCBSV) service, and we've [testified before the U.S. Congress](https://resources.sentilink.com/media/dr.-david-maimons-congressional-testimony-on-emerging-fraud-threats-and-the-evolving-fraud-landscape) on the future of identity. We want SentiLink to be the best place you've ever worked. We offer generous benefits and support a range of working arrangements, from fully remote to in-office. We are a digital-first company with strong collaboration across the U.S. and India, and we meet in person regularly to build relationships. We have offices in Austin, San Francisco, New York City, Seattle (Bellevue), Los Angeles, and Chicago in the U.S., and in Gurugram (Delhi) and Bengaluru in India. ## **Role:** SentiLink's Talent Acquisition team is responsible for building the teams that enable the company to grow. We partner closely with hiring managers and business leaders to identify, attract, and hire exceptional talent, while building the systems and processes that make recruiting more effective. We're looking for a Talent Acquisition Associate to join our team as an early-career recruiting generalist. You'll get hands-on exposure to all aspects of Talent Acquisition, from coordinating interviews and sourcing candidates to experimenting with AI tools, building better workflows, and taking on projects that help our team operate more effectively. We're looking for someone who's naturally curious, loves to tinker, and enjoys figuring out how to make things work better. You don't need prior recruiting experience, but you should be excited to learn, comfortable with technology, and willing to jump into whatever the team needs. This is a role for someone who takes ownership, cares about the details, and is willing to jump in wherever needed. Success means keeping recruiting running smoothly, helping us find great candidates, and making meaningful improvements to how our Talent Acquisition team operates. We are open to candidates at the beginning of their careers, including recent graduates. You don't need prior recruiting experience, but you should be able to show us how you have taken initiative, learned new tools, or built something that made a process better, whether through work, internships, school, or personal projects. **This role is based in our Austin office.** ***Applications will close on October 30, 2026.*** ## **Responsibilities:** - **Own interview coordination and recruiting logistics**, managing scheduling, candidate communication, and process details to ensure a seamless experience for candidates and hiring teams. - **Source and engage prospective candidates** across a variety of roles, using research, creative sourcing techniques, and AI-powered tools to identify talent and build pipelines. - **Experiment with AI tools and build lightweight solutions** to automate repetitive tasks, streamline recruiting workflows, and reduce manual work across the team. - **Support recruiters and hiring managers** throughout the hiring process, keeping candidate information accurate, processes organized, and searches moving forward. - **Identify and solve operational problems**, spotting inefficiencies, testing new approaches, and implementing practical improvements to how we work. - **Contribute to recruiting projects and initiatives**, including talent research, reporting, candidate experience improvements, process documentation, and new tools or workflows. - **Deliver a thoughtful candidate experience**, communicating clearly, following through on commitments, and ensuring candidates feel informed and supported. - **Jump in wherever the team needs help**, taking ownership of new tasks, learning unfamiliar tools or processes, and finding ways to add value beyond your day-to-day responsibilities. ## **Requirements:** - Bachelor's degree in any field. Recent graduates are encouraged to apply. - Demonstrated interest in AI and a builder mindset, with experience experimenting with AI tools, automations, or projects to solve problems and improve how work gets done. - Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple priorities, keep track of details, and consistently follow through. - Resourceful and comfortable figuring things out independently, whether that means learning a new tool, troubleshooting a workflow, or taking on an unfamiliar project. - Strong written and verbal communication skills, with a thoughtful, responsive approach to working with others. - Genuine interest in recruiting and talent sourcing, with the curiosity, persistence, and willingness to learn new sourcing techniques. - Previous experience in recruiting, coordination, operations, or a related field through internships, projects, or full-time work (preferred). ## **Compensation:** $75,000-$90,000/year + equity + benefits ## **Perks:** - Employer paid group health insurance for you and your dependents - 401(k) plan with employer match (or equivalent for non US-based roles) - Flexible paid time off - Regular company-wide in-person events - Home office stipend, and more! ## **Corporate Values:** - Follow Through - Deep Understanding - Whatever It Takes - Do Something Smart

Facility Launch & Operations Support and the appropriate functional owners guide facility projects, specialized work, approvals, and decisions outside the scope of this junior role. Welcome visitors and coordinate site access in accordance with Oklo’s security requirements. - Manage incoming and outgoing mail, shipping, office communications, and shared workplace information. - Respond to routine office requests and direct questions that need specialized support to the appropriate team. ### **People & Culture Support** - Coordinate the workplace portions of employee onboarding and offboarding, including workspaces, equipment, badges, and office orientation. - Lead in efforts to support and improve the facility experience for visitors. - description: At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most. **About the Organization** Now is a great time to join Redhorse Corporation. We are a solution-driven company delivering data insights and technology solutions to customers with missions critical to U.S. national interests. We’re looking for thoughtful, skilled professionals who thrive as trusted partners building technology-agnostic solutions and want to apply their talents supporting customers with difficult and important mission sets. **About the Role** Redhorse transforms the way government uses data and technology. To support this mission, we are seeking a motivated Junior GIS Analyst to serve as a Common Installation Picture (CIP) Helpdesk and SDSFIE Specialist on a long-term engagement supporting the Army National Guard (ARNG). This is a work-from-home position that **requires the candidate to be local to the Washington, D.C. metropolitan area** to support periodic local stakeholder coordination and meetings. You will perform as part of an integrated, mission-driven team dedicated to developing, maintaining, and reporting critical geospatial data layers depicting the built and natural environments across all ARNG States and Territories. Your work will directly empower ARNG leadership with real-time Situational Awareness (SA) over real property and environmental assets, maintaining strict data integrity through DoD and Army Geospatial Information Systems (GIS) standards. ### Key Responsibilities - **Data Aggregation & QA/QC:** Implement structured workflows for Quality Assurance/Quality Control (QA/QC) and enterprise aggregation of ARNG State and Territory geospatial data and metadata. - **CIP Quality Reporting:** Conduct data quality analyses and generate discrepancy reports utilizing Python-based validation tools to assess geodatabase geometry, schema, and attribution. - **Tool Maintenance & Optimization:** Identify, recommend, and execute modifications to existing CIP tools and Python scripts to optimize validation and reporting capabilities. - **Application Support:** Support and update the Geospatial Layer and Attribute Database (GLAD) application to meet evolving program specifications. - **Helpdesk Support & Troubleshooting:** Serve as a frontline technical resource to field questions, resolve user issues, and ensure efficient, compliant submission of CIP data from field installations. - **Standards Migration & Training:** Support the enterprise migration and compliance of Spatial Data Standards for Facilities, Infrastructure, and the Environment (SDSFIE), and facilitate user training sessions for stakeholders. ### Required Experience/Clearance - **Location:** Must be local to the Washington, D.C. metropolitan area (or within direct rail/commuting access) to attend periodic on-site meetings and customer engagements. - **Education & Experience**: Bachelor’s degree and a minimum of 2 years of related professional GIS experience. - **Programming & Scripting**: Working knowledge of Python, specifically for automating workflows and modifying geospatial validation scripts. - **GIS Expertise**: Demonstrated knowledge of GIS concepts, cartographic and geospatial production techniques, and digital spatial data formats. - **Software Proficiency**: Hands-on experience with ArcGIS Pro, SQL, and Microsoft Office Suite. - **Enterprise Systems**: Experience utilizing Enterprise GIS, Portal for ArcGIS, and ArcGIS Dashboards. - **Eligibility**: Must be a U.S. Citizen eligible to pass a federal background check/favorable suitability determination to support DoD systems. ### Desired Experience We encourage all candidates who meet the basic requirements to apply, even if you do not have any of the following experience: - **DoD & Military Familiarity**: Prior experience supporting military customers, with familiarity regarding military command structures, installation workflows, and decision-making processes. - **Data Standards**: Hands-on familiarity with SDSFIE schema requirements and real property asset management systems. - **Independent Drive**: Demonstrated ability to work effectively from home in a collaborative, distributed team environment. - **Adaptability & Communication**: Strong interpersonal communication skills, sharp attention to detail, and the flexibility to adapt to changing mission priorities.

description: Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years. **ABOUT THE JOB** The goal of Anduril’s Air Dominance and Strike Division is to fundamentally reshape the way future peer to peer conflicts are fought by developing next generation Collaborative Combat Aircraft (Fury), missiles such as RoadRunner and Barracuda, and the Mission Autonomy software that is the brain of these products. We’re in a race to build these products at scale. We need resilience in our supply chain, accelerate our ramp to production, iterate on design and quality through our test program, and ensure we’re maximizing operational effectiveness in the field. The operations that support and accelerate the product. The AD&S Operations team is a small but mighty team of business builder-operators who enable the division to scale through hyper-growth while breaking as few things as possible. We’re looking for an ambitious, strategic intern that wants to build to accelerate every step of the way. We’re building an end-to-end ecosystem of first-class, operational software solutions that leverages data and AI to build and operate our products rapidly, at scale. **WHAT YOU’LL DO** - Embed with various engineers to understand their workflows and locate their critical problems and bottlenecks - Identify, structure and leverage various data systems that enables us to build tailored data-driven solutions - Develop operational apps in a scrappy but effective way, work closely with users to iterate and support outcomes - Build systems and infrastructure that allows applications to mature, roll out and scale in the field - Work closely with Anduril’s corporate Analytics team to expand our ontologies and generalize our data and workflow applications across the entire company **REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS** - Must be pursuing a bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Physics, or a related field. - Must be returning to school at the end of the internship to continue academic studies for at least one quarter or semester. - Must be a U.S. Person due to required access to U.S. export-controlled information or facilities; U.S. clearance eligibility may be required depending on program. - Ability to complete a 12-week in-person internship in Costa Mesa, CA, or Ashville, OH, in summer 2027. **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** - Engineering fundamentals - Computer Science, Engineering, Physics or similar background - You’re deeply intellectually interested in the intersection of analytics and the real, physical, atoms-based, hardware world and are motivated by Anduril’s mission - You’re energized by business impact & a self-starter: you’d rather build an imperfect solution quickly that is used by many people than a perfect solution that collects dust - Proof of delivery - you owned a project end-to-end from ambiguity to delivered, scaleable outcome - Coding experience - used python, SQL, react, typescript or equivalent - Data system exposure: dbt, Redshift, Looker/Tableau, Databricks, Palantir Foundry US Hourly Range $24—$45 USD The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. **About Norm Ai** Norm Ai, the agentic law company, has a client base with a combined $30 trillion in assets under management. Norm Ai pioneered Legal Engineering, the process that empowers lawyers to build and supervise domain-specific AI agents with Norm’s proprietary suite of no-code software tools. Norm Ai technology is deployed inside many of the largest and most consequential institutions in the world. Norm Ai is also the technology behind Norm Law, LLP, a separate but affiliated AI-native law firm built for the era of agentic AI. Norm Law’s attorneys advise leading institutions across private funds, private equity, venture capital, real estate, registered funds, and financial regulation, using the same legal intelligence platform that powers Norm Ai’s products. **AI Fluency:** Norm Ai prefers all team members to be fluent in AI. Successful candidates actively use AI in their day-to-day work to support thinking, creation, and problem-solving. They use it to improve the quality and speed of their work and to continuously refine how work gets done end-to-end. Candidates should be prepared to demonstrate and discuss their AI usage throughout the interview process, including concrete examples of tools, workflows, and outcomes. We look for practical, hands-on experience, not theoretical familiarity. # **Overview of Role** As Junior Counsel, you'll work directly with and report to Norm's Head of Legal and Managing Partner of Norm Law, LLP, and closely collaborate with the Head of Norm Law Operations. This is a true generalist role supporting the full legal function at Norm Ai and the legal and operational needs of Norm Law, spanning corporate, commercial, employment, IP, and data security, as well as the business and go-to-market operations of an AI-native law firm. This role is designed for an ambitious lawyer who wants broad practice-area coverage and who thrives in a fast-paced, high-ownership environment. You'll sit at the intersection of law and AI and see firsthand how the future of legal practice is being built, take on meaningful responsibility early, and grow into a trusted right hand to the Head of Legal. Success in this role requires excellent judgment, exceptional organization, discretion with sensitive matters, and the range and curiosity to move fluidly across legal disciplines and between legal and business problems. # **Core Objectives & Responsibilities** ## **Corporate, Equity & Governance** - Support the company's corporate and governance needs, including board and stockholder consents, resolutions, and other entity matters - Help administer equity and maintain the cap table, and keep corporate records and filings in order across the company and its subsidiaries - Develop a working understanding of the governance and relationship between Norm Ai and Norm Law and work with Norm Law operations to help administer it effectively ## **Commercial & Norm Law Go-To-Market** - Draft and review commercial agreements (NDAs, MSAs, SOWs, vendor contracts) and build repeatable templates and playbooks - Review engagement letters and client proposals and support client intake for Norm Law - Help operationalize and systematize a go-to-market motion as an ongoing part of the role ## **Employment, IP & Data Security** - Support day-to-day employment and HR matters and help maintain employment templates, policies, and handbooks as the team scales, with an eye to multi-state and multi-jurisdiction compliance - Manage IP ownership, assignment, and protection, and help safeguard the company's confidential information and trade secrets - Support data privacy and security compliance, including customer and vendor data terms, privacy policies, and evolving regulatory requirements ## **Strategic Collaboration & Enablement** - Coordinate with outside counsel, prepare materials, and learn when matters should be escalated - Build the legal function's infrastructure — matter tracking, templates, and approval workflows - Partner cross-functionally with leadership, Operations,People/Talent, and the Norm Law team to support the business # **Skills & Experience: Core** - JD and barred in at least one state (NY preferred), with 2–3 years of experience at a top-tier law firm and / or in-house at a high-growth company - A generalist by inclination, meaning you want broad coverage across corporate, commercial, employment, IP, and data privacy / security rather than a single area of practice - Strong corporate / transactional foundation, with the range and curiosity to pick up adjacent areas quickly - Exceptional judgment, discretion, and ownership; you will need to be trusted with sensitive corporate, personnel, and client matters - Pragmatic and business-minded; you find the path to “yes” with appropriate guardrails and are comfortable supporting a commercial / GTM function, not just providing legal review - Highly organized and systems-oriented, with a low-ego, action-oriented mindset and no task too big or too small # **Skills & Experience: Pluses** - Exposure to startup equity, employment matters, IP, data privacy, or venture financings - Familiarity with law firm operations or professional-services go-to-market - Genuine enthusiasm for AI and what it means for the future of legal services # **What Success Looks Like** ## **30 Days** - Complete onboarding and develop a deep understanding of Norm Ai and Norm Law, their structures, and the governance between them - Begin handling routine corporate, commercial, and employment matters with guidance ## **60 Days** - Independently own recurring workstreams, routine legal administrative matters, standard commercial agreements, and provide support to various internal Norm Ai teams - Serve as a reliable reviewer of GTM engagement letters and proposals - Begin building templates and process improvements across the legal function ## **90 Days** - Operate as a trusted generalist, owning matters end-to-end with appropriate escalation - Be a go-to resource for GTM legal support and internal legal questions - Drive systematization of the legal function's infrastructure and workflows # ## **Compensation and Benefits** **Base salary:** $200,000 - $250,000 The range displayed in this job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire salary for this position. Within the range, individual pay is determined by various factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. **Equity:** Included **Benefits:** 401(k) with employer match, health, dental, vision coverage, unlimited paid time off, free lunch in office daily, employee referral bonus program **Relocation:** Financial support to ease your move to New York City, designed to make the transition smooth and stress-free. ## **Work Location** **Location:** NYC **Work model:** Hybrid **In-office expectation:** We are in our 1 WTC HQ 4–5 days per week *Norm Ai is a technology and service provider to Norm Law. Norm Ai does not provide legal advice or services. All legal advice or services are provided solely by Norm Law, through its fully-licensed attorneys.* To learn more about Norm Ai, visit our [**website**](https://www.norm.ai).

description: # Who we are: Geotab ® is a global leader in IoT and connected transportation and certified “Great Place to Work™.” We are a company of diverse and talented individuals who work together to help businesses grow and succeed, and increase the safety and sustainability of our communities. Geotab is advancing security, connecting commercial vehicles to the internet and providing web-based analytics to help customers better manage their fleets. Geotab’s open platform and Geotab Marketplace ®, offering hundreds of third-party solution options, allows both small and large businesses to automate operations by integrating vehicle data with their other data assets. Processing billions of data points a day, Geotab leverages data analytics and machine learning to improve productivity, optimize fleets through the reduction of fuel consumption, enhance driver safety and achieve strong compliance to regulatory changes. Our team is growing and we’re looking for people who follow their passion, think differently and want to make an impact. Ours is a fast paced, ever changing environment. Geotabbers accept that challenge and are willing to take on new tasks and activities - ones that may not always be described in the initial job description. Join us for a fulfilling career with opportunities to innovate, great benefits, and our fun and inclusive work culture. Reach your full potential with Geotab. To see what it’s like to be a Geotabber, check out our [blog](https://careers.geotab.com/blog/) and follow us @InsideGeotab on [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/insidegeotab/). # Who you are: We are always looking for amazing talent who can contribute to our growth and deliver results! Geotab is seeking a Business Development Coordinator Intern to help launch and grow the Geotab Fleet Card. This position will support the business side of reseller and customer engagement for the card: tracking applications and enrollments, preparing outreach, and working with our sales channels and payments partners to turn interest into active, spending customers. If you love technology, are curious about how fleets buy fuel and manage costs, and want to join an industry leader at the launch of a new product, we would love to hear from you! # What you'll do: As a Business Development Coordinator Intern, your key area of responsibility will be helping the Fleet Card team move opportunities from first interest to a completed application and first transaction. You will support reseller and direct customer outreach, keep the opportunity pipeline accurate, and help us understand what is working. Typical projects include tracking card applications and follow-ups, matching prospects to Salesforce accounts and contacts, preparing outreach drafts and sales materials, and building reports on adoption and pipeline. You will work closely with the Fleet Card extended team, Geotab Sales Channels (Partner Account Managers and Sales Specialists), Marketing, Solution Engineering, Resellers/Partners, and our card and payments partners. To be successful in this role you will be detail oriented, able to multitask, and a strong written communicator. In addition, the successful candidate will have strong analytical skills and a solid background in Google Sheets/Microsoft Excel, which our team uses for reporting. # The opportunity: - 8 - 12 month work-term beginning January 2027. - Full-time, paid internship: Monday - Friday, 37.5hrs/week. - Your first week at Geotab begins with 'GEO Launch' - a one-week Employee Orientation. Click [here](https://www.geotab.com/blog/first-week/) to learn more! - Learn more about the Geotab Campus Program [here](https://www.geotab.com/blog/geotab-campus-program/). - This posting is for an existing vacancy. # How you'll make an impact: - Track Fleet Card applications and enrollments, and help follow up with applicants who started but did not finish. - Maintain the Fleet Card opportunity tracker, including enterprise, government and reseller-sourced opportunities, and keep Salesforce records accurate. - Research and build prospect lists by segment, size and fuel-spend profile, honoring exclusion rules (existing card customers, account owner coverage and partner conflicts). - Prepare and QA outreach drafts, invitations and follow-up sequences for review by the team before they are sent. - Coordinate the aggregation of sales, training and enablement materials for internal stakeholders, resellers and end customers, communicating the business problems the card solves. - Work with Partner Account Managers and resellers to drive Fleet Card adoption and expand existing opportunities. - Build weekly reporting on applications, activations, credit lines and pipeline, and highlight trends and risks to the team. - Support marketing launch activity, including in-product campaigns, email and social content, and measure their results. - Support RFP and bid preparation by gathering data, drafting responses and checking details for accuracy. - Assist the VP with needs across the team and support our team goals and mission. # What you'll bring to the role: - Currently pursuing a degree in Business, Marketing, Finance, Supply Chain or a related field. - Experience in sales operations, business development, project coordination or a similar area (internships and coursework count). - Ability to understand customers' business needs; interest in fleet operations, fuel costs or fintech is a plus. - High accuracy and meticulous attention to detail. - Excellent proofreading and written communication skills. - Strong analytical skills, with the ability to problem solve and make well-judged decisions. - Technical competence with Google Workspace (Sheets, Docs, Slides) and/or Microsoft Excel; familiarity with Salesforce or another CRM is an asset. - Highly organized, able to manage multiple tasks and projects and respond to fast-changing priorities and deadlines. - Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to engage with all levels of the organization. - A team player with an entrepreneurial mindset who is comfortable in a flat organization. If you got this far, we hope you're feeling excited about this role! Even if you don't feel you meet every single requirement, we still encourage you to apply. **Please note: Geotab does not accept agency resumes and is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes. Please do not forward resumes to Geotab employees.** # How we work: At Geotab, we thrive on a flexible hybrid work model that combines the dynamic energy and connection of in-person collaboration with the independence and flexibility of virtual work. We believe that coming together in person is fundamental to cultivating trust, nurturing a vibrant culture of belonging, and fostering meaningful innovation across our diverse teams. Office visit schedules are tailored thoughtfully based on role requirements. Specific expectations regarding workplace location and on-site attendance for this position will be shared during the hiring process. We believe that ensuring diversity is fundamental to our future growth and progress and is an integral part of our business. We believe that success happens where new ideas can flourish – in an environment that is rich in diversity and a place where people from various backgrounds can work together. Geotab encourages applications from all qualified individuals. We are committed to accommodating people with disabilities during the recruitment and assessment processes and when people are hired. We will ensure the accessibility needs of employees with disabilities are taken into account as part of performance management, career development, training and redeployment processes. If you require accommodation at any stage of the application process or want more information about our diversity and inclusion as well as accommodation policies and practices, please contact us at . Founded in 2014, the Company’s mission is to disrupt the automotive and technology industries by creating user-centric, technology-first experiences. The Company, together with its controlled subsidiaries, operates across multiple technology-driven areas, including AI electric vehicles, robotics, and its crypto business (AIXC), all under its upgraded Global EAI Industry Bridge Strategy, marking the beginning of a new chapter in AI mobility and Web3 integration. The Company aims to leverage the latest technologies and world’s best talent to realize exciting new possibilities across all of these lines. Faraday Future’s automotive business exemplifies its vision for luxury, innovation, and performance, while its FX strategy aims to introduce mass production models equipped with state-of-the-art luxury technology derived from the FF brand, targeted towards a broader market with middle-to-low price range offerings. FF is committed to redefining mobility through AI innovation. Join us in shaping the future of intelligent transportation and technology by creating something new, something connected, and something with a true global impact. **Your Role:** The **Intern – Aftersales Customer Relations & Voice of Customer (VOC)** will support the Aftersales operations team in maintaining high standards of customer satisfaction and case management. Reporting within the Aftersales department, this role assists with customer communications, case tracking within the CRM system, Voice of Customer (VOC) feedback collection, and cross-functional coordination with Quality, Engineering, and Operations. This internship offers hands-on experience in customer success, CRM administration, and service operations within an innovative AI electric vehicle and robotics company. **Key Responsibilities:** **Customer Experience** - Support customer communication throughout the service process. - Respond to customer inquiries under the guidance of the Aftersales team. - Assist with customer follow-up after repairs, deliveries, and service campaigns. - Help maintain a positive customer experience. **CRM & Case Management** - Create and update customer cases within the CRM system. - Maintain accurate customer records and service history. - Assist with tracking open customer cases through completion. - Monitor Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and notify the team of overdue cases. **Voice of Customer (VOC)** - Collect customer feedback through surveys and follow-up communications. - Assist with preparing VOC reports and trend summaries. - Help identify recurring customer concerns for management review. - Support continuous improvement initiatives based on customer feedback. **Customer Communications** - Assist with scheduling customer appointments. - Coordinate customer communications regarding repair status and service updates. - Support logistics for parts shipments, returns, and warranty activities. - Help prepare customer communication templates and documentation. **Administrative Support** - Maintain accurate service records. - Assist with document preparation and filing. - Support Aftersales projects and special assignments. - Participate in department meetings and training activities. **Learning Opportunities** The intern will gain experience in: - Customer Relations & VOC Reporting - CRM Administration (Zendesk, Salesforce, or equivalent) - Warranty Administration & Repair Order Workflow - Customer Case Management & Service Campaigns - Mobile Field Operations & Robotics Aftersales - Cross-functional collaboration with Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain, and Operation. **Basic Qualifications:** **Experience:** - Prior experience in customer service, call center operations, retail, hospitality, or client-facing support roles (0–2 years of experience). **Education:** - High School Graduate **Technical Skills:** - Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook). - Familiarity with basic web applications, email handling, and computer systems (experience with CRM software like Zendesk or Salesforce is a plus). **Communication & Detail Orientation:** - Strong verbal and written communication abilities with a customer-first mindset. - Excellent organizational skills and high attention to detail. - Ability to multi-task and manage customer inquiries efficiently in a fast-paced environment. - Positive attitude with a focus on problem-solving and team collaboration. **Travel:** - Ability to travel up to 10% as required to support customer visits, training, meetings, and company events. **Preferred Qualifications:** - Prior experience with CRM systems such as Zendesk, Salesforce, or similar tools. - Interest in automotive, electric vehicles, robotics, or advanced technology. - Demonstrated experience working effectively in a team-oriented startup environment. **Work Schedule** - Ability to support after-hours, weekend, or holiday customer activities during product launches, customer events, or critical business needs. **Salary Range:** $18/hour **Perks + Benefits** - Healthcare + dental + vision benefits (Free for you/discounted for family) - 401(k) options - Casual dress code + relaxed work environment - Culturally diverse, progressive atmosphere - “Soul of Faraday” community outreach team Faraday Future is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other legally protected status.

description: Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years. **ABOUT THE JOB** We are looking for Product Sourcing Engineer interns to join our rapidly growing teams. In this role, you will be responsible for driving the strategic supply network development and cost management of Anduril’s product hardware, across their lifecycles, by collaborating with suppliers and cross-functionally, including stakeholders in engineering, quality, and manufacturing. **WHAT YOU’LL DO** - Conduct supplier selection for a specific product, leveraging approved supplier list. - Partner with strategic suppliers to accelerate product development via activities such as: - Concept scoping to quickly solidify requirements - Feature trade-off / trade tables - Total Cost of Ownership modeling - Joint design development, via clear statements of work - Simulation of mechanical & electronics designs - Develop and execute on sourcing strategy via full market knowledge, supplier rationalization, commodity pricing plan and effective principles to drive efficiency and cost - Drive the development and consolidation of a manufacturing BOM, working with Quality & Manufacturing, to ramp production internally and with our suppliers with high flexibility - Be accountable for all NPI component procurement, on-time and correctly, to scale up manufacturing operations - Manage the request for and associated verification of supplier related CAPEX throughout NPI - Conduct value-stream mapping to optimize supply network lead time and flexibility - Complete the BOM risk assessment and develop plan per part analysis - Follow through completion of component qualifications by relevant stakeholders, ahead of production need dates - Reduce complexity of supply chain through commonality optimization & component/supplier rationalization - Lead all cost engineering activities to converge the bottoms-up cost curve to product cost, maximizing the total cost of ownership (TCO) across the product lifecycle - Manage ad-hoc cost issues e.g., tariffs / import export cost, and cost inflation - Drive the design and implementation of new supply chain processes and systems, ensuring they meet business requirements and are built for scale - Manage project schedules, identify critical path activities, and proactively identify and mitigate risks to keep initiatives on track - Hold project teams and stakeholders accountable for deliverables and deadlines, navigating organizational complexity to clear roadblocks and drive decisions - Establish program structure, milestones, and operating rhythms to ensure accountability and drive results across the business - Drive alignment across stakeholders and influence without formal authority in ambiguous, high-stakes situations **REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS** - Must be pursuing a bachelor’s or master’s degree in Engineering, or a related technical field. - Must be returning to school at the end of the internship to continue academic studies for at least one quarter or semester. - Must be a U.S. Person due to required access to U.S. export-controlled information or facilities; U.S. clearance eligibility may be required depending on program. - Ability to complete a 12-week in-person internship in one of our offices in summer 2027. **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** - Background within: - Design & development of mechanical and/or electronics devices - Advanced sourcing activities, including positions working as a commodity/sourcing manager - Supplier development (technology, process, supply chain, etc.) - Early supplier engagement, ahead of product/engineering requirement realization - Exposure to value/procurement engineering or TCO-related work at the component & product level - Familiarity with developing high-tech products in a high-mix, low-volume environment US Hourly Range $32—$45 USD The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including: ### **Benefits** At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. *For more information, [Explore Our Benefits](https://www.anduril.com/careers).* ### **Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams** Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information. To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind: - **No Financial Requests:**Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates. - **Please always verify communications:** - Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will *only* come from an `@anduril.com` address. - Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to [contact@anduril.com](mailto:contact@anduril.com). - **Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach:** If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links. - **What to Do If You Suspect Fraud:** Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to [contact@anduril.com](mailto:contact@anduril.com). Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts. ### ### **Data Privacy** To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit . By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

As our new intern, you will be a part of Ramboll’s diverse, creative, and collaborative team.
