Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years. Maritime Digital Production is the software and digital systems function within Anduril's Heavy Metal division. We build and deploy the technology stack that powers Anduril's shipbuilding factories: the data infrastructure that makes every machine and sensor visible in real time, the manufacturing execution system that workers and planners use every shift, the scheduling engine that replans production in minutes instead of days, and the AI systems that remove manual toil from the shop floor and business operations. That includes Serapis, our program building components for the Virginia-class submarine. We operate at the boundary between Operational Technology and Information Technology, incubating solutions close to the production line, validating them with real operators, hardening them for reliability and security, and scaling them across sites. The environment is fast, physical, and consequential. When our systems go down, production stops. The output of our work is not a dashboard: it is a ship. We are scaling from a founding team to more than 70 engineers across multiple U.S. sites. As an intern you join early, on a problem that matters to production, with a defined project and a named engineer you work with every day. We have built a computational geometry engine that takes a 3D CAD assembly and works out the orders in which it can physically come apart, and therefore the orders in which it can be built. It finds where parts touch, builds directional blocking graphs from that contact geometry, searches for collision-free removal directions, and produces the precedence constraints our production scheduling system plans against. It works on small and mid-sized assemblies. It needs to work on the assemblies we actually build, which have hundreds to thousands of parts. Your job is to close that gap. This is algorithms engineering with a research flavor. You will profile the engine on real assemblies, find where the time and memory go, and attack it: search ordering, pruning, memorization, incremental updates, subassembly decomposition, and parallelism. The goal is a measurably faster engine rather than a paper, and every result is held to one rule: a faster answer that is a different answer is a bug. **WHAT YOU’LL DO** - Profiling a C++ computational geometry pipeline on real assemblies and reporting where time and memory go - Designing and implementing algorithmic improvements to a disassembly sequence search: candidate ordering, pruning, memoization, and incremental graph updates - Decomposing large assemblies into subassemblies that can be solved independently - Parallelizing expensive geometric tests across cores without losing determinism - Building a benchmark corpus and harness that run in continuous integration and catch regressions - Gating every optimization on output equivalence against a reference set - Writing up results and presenting them to the engineering team **REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS** - Must be pursuing master’s degree or PhD in Computer Science, Robotics, Mechanical Engineering, Applied Mathematics, or a related field. - Must be returning to school at the end of the internship to continue academic studies for at least one quarter or semester. - Must be a U.S. Person due to required access to U.S. export-controlled information or facilities; U.S. clearance eligibility may be required depending on program. - Ability to complete an in-person co-op in Santa Ana, CA, in winter 2027. **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** - Strong modern C++, C++17 or later. You have written and debugged performance-sensitive C++ in a codebase you did not write yourself, not only coursework. - Solid algorithms and data structures, including graph algorithms such as strongly connected components and topological ordering, combinatorial search and pruning, and complexity analysis. - Computational geometry fundamentals: triangle meshes, bounding volume hierarchies and other spatial indexes, intersection and collision tests, and reasoning about directions on the sphere. - Experience profiling and optimizing code. You have used a profiler and made something measurably faster. - Research or coursework in assembly sequence planning, disassembly planning, or motion planning. If you know what a non-directional blocking graph is, or have read Wilson and Latombe or the STAAT work by Romney and colleagues, we want to talk to you. - Publications at ICRA, IROS, RSS, SoCG, or Solid and Physical Modeling, or in the Computer-Aided Design journal. - Experience with Eigen, OpenCASCADE, OpenVDB, CGAL, or a collision or bounding volume hierarchy library. - Parallel programming in C++ with Intel TBB, OpenMP, or standard threads, with attention to determinism. - Familiarity with CAD data: boundary representations versus tessellated meshes, and formats such as STEP and JT. - Experience with CMake, GoogleTest, and reproducible builds. Nix is a plus. - Python for tooling and analysis, e.g. NumPy and trimesh. - Familiarity with infinitesimal motion analysis or rotational motions in assembly planning. At Prosek Partners, the stories we tell impact the global economy. Prosek's Talent Acquisition Apprentice Program is a six-month development program designed for recent graduates who are interested in launching a career in recruiting and human resources and demonstrate strong potential, curiosity and drive. Throughout the program, Apprentices gain hands-on experience supporting Prosek's Talent Acquisition team while developing foundational skills in recruiting, candidate engagement, sourcing, research and recruitment operations. Apprentices also participate in structured professional development, mentorship and ongoing feedback designed to accelerate their growth. The program provides Apprentices with the opportunity to build and demonstrate the skills needed to succeed in a full-time Talent Acquisition role at Prosek. Based on individual performance, demonstrated readiness and business needs, Apprentices may be considered for a full-time opportunity during or at the conclusion of the six-month program. Conversion to a full-time role is not guaranteed. **Program Overview and Responsibilities** **What You'll Do** As a Talent Acquisition Apprentice, you will: - Support the Talent Acquisition team throughout the recruitment process, including coordinating candidate interviews, collecting post-interview feedback and facilitating candidate communications. - Help deliver a "white glove" candidate experience by ensuring timely communication, providing updates and serving as a reliable point of contact throughout the interview process. - Develop foundational sourcing skills by researching prospective candidates through platforms such as LinkedIn and helping build talent pipelines for current and future hiring needs. - Support recruitment operations and reporting by maintaining accurate candidate records, updating recruitment trackers and managing candidate profiles within Greenhouse, our applicant tracking system. - Assist with drafting and posting job descriptions, promoting opportunities and supporting recruitment outreach initiatives. - Gain exposure to the candidate evaluation and selection process, including understanding candidate qualifications, interview feedback and hiring considerations. - Conduct research on prospective candidates, recruiting trends and talent markets to support hiring strategies. - Collaborate with the Talent Acquisition and broader HR teams to support recruiting initiatives and hiring priorities across the firm. - Develop an understanding of Prosek's business, culture and hiring needs to effectively communicate career opportunities to prospective candidates. - Take on increasing ownership and responsibility as you demonstrate proficiency in foundational Talent Acquisition skills. **Professional Development and Training** Professional development is a core component of the Apprentice experience. Talent Acquisition Apprentices will participate in structured learning and development opportunities designed to complement hands-on recruiting experience and build the foundational skills needed to succeed in Talent Acquisition and HR. Training may include: - Time Management 101 - Organization & Resourcefulness - Applicant Tracking Systems & Recruitment Reporting - Understanding Prosek's Business & Practice Areas Apprentices may also have opportunities to participate in broader Prosek professional development programming and learn from colleagues and leaders across the firm. **Internal Network and Support** Apprentices are supported by a dedicated network designed to accelerate their development and help them successfully transition into a professional environment. Each Apprentice will have access to: - A Manager who provides ongoing feedback, identifies strengths and development areas, and helps establish goals for progression. - A Mentor who provides broader career guidance and support as the Apprentice acclimates to Prosek and the professional workplace. - Regular performance check-ins to discuss progress, development priorities and readiness for increased responsibility. **Experience and Qualifications** - Bachelor's degree completed by the start of the program. - Strong interest in pursuing a career in Talent Acquisition, recruiting or human resources. - Strong written and verbal communication skills. - Excellent organizational, time management and prioritization skills. - Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple responsibilities. - Strong research and critical-thinking skills. - Collaborative, team-oriented mindset with a willingness to jump in and support the team wherever needed. - Ability to handle sensitive information with professionalism and discretion. - Resourceful, proactive and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment. - Eagerness to learn, receive feedback and develop new skills. - Previous recruiting, HR or related internship experience is welcomed but not required. **Salary:** $23.00/hour **Our Core Values** - **Chemistry, Collaboration and Belonging:** Our collegial culture inspires people with different perspectives and backgrounds to work towards common goals as we brainstorm, plan and execute on behalf of our clients and build our business together. - **Grit and Hustle**: We work hard. We roll up our sleeves. We are not precious or pretentious. We do not take shortcuts. Instead, we put in the work and do what it takes to get the job done. - **The Excitement of New Challenges**: We view challenges as opportunities and embrace them. They motivate us to learn and grow so that we can be the best versions of ourselves, for our clients and each other. - **A Workplace with Humanity:**We recognize the rigor and demands of our work. We also recognize that life inside and outside of Prosek can be stressful. We work very hard to run our business with a heavy dose of humanity and to make Prosek a safe place where people enjoy the work and each other. **Our Beliefs on Culture, Diversity & Belonging** We are committed to building a diverse workforce reflecting and embracing diversity of all kinds – diversity of geography, cognitive diversity, race, ethnicity, age, gender identity, sexual orientation, political affiliation and socioeconomic backgrounds. We believe having teams that represent the broader communities where we live and work creates a culture that celebrates creativity, inclusiveness and teamwork and helps us offer our global clientele of mature and emerging businesses counsel that is dynamic, rich and nuanced. description: Franklin University, a private, independent, accredited, nonprofit university located in Columbus, Ohio, invites applications for the position of Director, Student Wellbeing & Access. Founded in 1902, Franklin University has built its reputation on removing barriers to higher education for ambitious adults balancing educational goals with work, family, and other commitments. Accredited and nonprofit, Franklin is recognized as an innovator in online education and serves students through applied undergraduate, master's, and doctoral programs designed to support career advancement and lifelong learning. More than 50,000 Franklin alumni live and work around the world, making meaningful contributions to their professions and communities. Position Summary The Director, Student Wellbeing & Access will provide strategic and operational leadership for initiatives that promote student wellbeing, accessibility, accountability, persistence, and success at Franklin University. Reporting to the Dean of Students, this role oversees Accessibility Services, Student Wellbeing, and Community Standards, while serving as the University's ADA/Section 504 Coordinator and Title IX Coordinator. The Director will lead efforts to identify and address barriers that may interfere with student engagement and academic progress, developing innovative, scalable approaches to student support that meet the needs of Franklin's diverse and geographically dispersed student population. This includes advancing disability access and accommodations, strengthening student wellbeing resources, and providing oversight for complex student matters and institutional compliance responsibilities. As a key member of the Dean of Students leadership team, the Director will foster collaboration across the University, leverage data and technology to improve student services, and promote a culture of accountability, compassion, continuous improvement, and student-centered support. Key Responsibilities The Director provides strategic and operational leadership for Accessibility Services, Student Wellbeing, and Community Standards, ensuring these functions support student engagement, persistence, and success. The Director serves as the University's ADA/Section 504 Coordinator and Title IX Coordinator, overseeing disability accommodations, institutional accessibility, regulatory compliance, and related policies and procedures. This role leads the development of proactive, scalable, and virtual-first student wellbeing initiatives designed to address nonacademic barriers to student success, including oversight of the Student Emergency Fund and partnerships that expand access to student resources and support. The Director also provides leadership for student conduct, grievances, appeals, and other complex student matters, ensuring fair, consistent, and timely resolution. Responsibilities include coordinating responses to concerns submitted through the University's anonymous reporting system and participating on the Franklin Intervention & Awareness Team (FIAT). The Director supervises and develops professional staff, collaborates with University leaders to strengthen student support and institutional practices, and leverages data, technology, and process improvements to enhance service delivery and operational effectiveness. As a member of the Dean of Students leadership team, the Director promotes a culture of accountability, compassion, innovation, and continuous improvement while exercising sound judgment and discretion in sensitive matters. Minimum Qualifications A master's degree in higher education, student affairs, counseling, rehabilitation counseling, education, law, public administration, social work, or a related field is required, along with a minimum of five years of progressively responsible experience in higher education. Candidates must have meaningful experience in postsecondary disability or accessibility services, including demonstrated knowledge of the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA), Section 504, the interactive accommodation process, and related regulatory requirements. The successful candidate will have supervisory experience, a broad understanding of Student Affairs practices, and experience supporting students with complex needs or circumstances affecting their success. Demonstrated ability to interpret and apply institutional policies and regulatory requirements, including student conduct, grievances, investigations, or related resolution processes, is essential. Knowledge of Title IX requirements, strong leadership and communication skills, sound judgment, and the ability to manage sensitive and confidential matters with discretion, neutrality, and compassion are also required. Additional Information This position follows an on-site hybrid work schedule and requires flexibility to meet departmental and university needs. Occasional evening and weekend availability may be required to address sensitive or time-sensitive student matters, and some travel may be expected. Franklin offers a competitive benefits package, incentive program, and free parking. In addition, Franklin provides free undergraduate tuition for employees and eligible family members, graduate tuition assistance for full-time employees and eligible family members, and a discount on doctoral tuition for employees. Franklin University is committed to creating a respectful and inclusive educational and workplace environment. Franklin does not discriminate on the basis of age, religion, race, ethnicity, color, national origin, ancestry, immigration status, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital or familial status, disability, or veteran or military status.

description: ## About Us Fanatics is building a leading global digital sports platform. We ignite the passions of global sports fans and maximize the presence and reach for our hundreds of sports partners globally by offering products and services across Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, and Fanatics Betting & Gaming, allowing sports fans to Buy, Collect, and Bet. Through the Fanatics platform, sports fans can buy licensed fan gear, jerseys, lifestyle and streetwear products, headwear, and hardgoods; collect physical and digital trading cards, sports memorabilia, and other digital assets; and bet as the company builds its Sportsbook and iGaming platform. Fanatics has an established database of over 100 million global sports fans; a global partner network with approximately 900 sports properties, including major national and international professional sports leagues, players associations, teams, colleges, college conferences and retail partners, 2,500 athletes and celebrities, and 200 exclusive athletes; and over 2,000 retail locations, including its Lids retail stores. Our more than 22,000 employees are committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience and delighting sports fans globally. As we continue to scale our global platform, the Licensing Partnerships Intern will play a critical role in supporting Fanatics' college licensing agreements and partner event execution. #### ROLE OVERVIEW The Licensing Partnerships Intern supports the College Licensing team by tracking sales and royalty guarantees, maintaining active license records, and providing analytical insights tied to authorized direct licensees (ADLs). This role is central to planning and executing Fanatics College's annual event calendar — spanning CALS, SBJ/NFF, Tailgate, CFP, Final Four, CLC Seminar, NACDA/ICLA, and Fanatics Fest — and building the operational infrastructure that enables Partner Development and College GM teams to maximize event impact. The Licensing Partnerships Intern delivers business and fan impact through BOLD leadership and execution excellence, leveraging data, automation, and AI-enabled insights. #### HOW WILL YOU DRIVE IMPACT Success is measured by the ability to deliver results through BOLD capabilities and measurable outcomes. Team & Leadership Impact (Build Championship Teams) - Collaborate cross-functionally with the Partner Development and College GM teams to ensure alignment on licensing data, event logistics, and partner-facing deliverables. - Support internal stakeholders by maintaining and distributing accurate business trackers, meeting materials, and consolidated planning grids that enable the broader team to operate efficiently. - Contribute to a productive debrief process following major events, helping the team capture learnings and improve execution cycles. Fan & Customer Impact (Obsessed with Fans) - Help deliver standout college partner experiences by supporting flawless execution of marquee events including CFP, Final Four, and Fanatics Fest — ensuring every logistical detail reflects the Fanatics brand. - Maintain up-to-date records of active licenses to ensure fans and partners are always served by accurate, current agreement data. - Submit new product and/or distribution channel requests that expand the reach of officially licensed college merchandise to more fans. - Provide insights tied to ADL sales performance that inform how partner products are positioned and supported in the market. Innovation & Problem Solving (Limitless Entrepreneurial Spirit) - Build scalable planning infrastructure — including attendee and registration lists, master session schedules, available meeting windows and spaces, and team meeting grids — that transforms event execution from reactive to proactive. - Identify opportunities to streamline recurring processes such as deck population, royalty tracking, and business tracker updates through smarter templates and data workflows. - Bring a solutions-oriented mindset to administrative and operational challenges, proposing improvements as patterns and inefficiencies are identified. Ownership & Execution (Determined & Relentless Mindset) - Track sales and royalty guarantees under Fanatics' college licensing agreements and deliver timely, accurate insights to the College GM team. - Create and maintain deck templates for recurring partner business meetings, ensuring materials are populated with current data and ready ahead of each meeting. - Manage vendor coordination, on-site materials, travel and logistics, and invite and registration lists across the full Fanatics College annual event calendar. - Provide reliable administrative support across the Licensing Partnerships team, handling a broad range of tasks with attention to detail and follow-through. #### AI & DIGITAL CAPABILITY We are building a future-ready organization. This role is expected to: - Apply AI and technology to improve efficiency, quality, and outcomes - Use data and digital tools to inform decisions and enhance performance - Demonstrate curiosity and adaptability in adopting new technologies and ways of working - Contribute to a culture of innovation and continuous improvement #### CAPABILITIES & EXPERIENCE YOU BRING Required Qualifications: - Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple workstreams — including licensing data tracking, event planning, and partner meeting preparation — simultaneously and accurately. - Proficiency in Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets for tracking sales, royalty guarantees, and business metrics; comfort building and maintaining data trackers and templates. - Experience or demonstrated interest in sports licensing, partnerships, or collegiate athletics business environments. - Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to create clear, professional materials for partner-facing meetings and internal stakeholders. - Detail-oriented approach to record-keeping, including maintaining active license records and populating recurring reporting templates with precision. - Ability to support event logistics end-to-end — from invite lists and registration to vendor coordination, on-site materials, and post-event debriefs — across a multi-event annual calendar. - Self-starter mindset with the ability to take initiative on administrative and operational tasks and flag issues proactively to senior team members. #### WORK LOCATION Hybrid: The primary place of performance of this role is the Company's office located in Norman, OK, Jacksonville, FL or Tampa, FL, subject to the Company's current hybrid work policy. This role currently requires in-office presence 3 days per week. At Fanatics, we operate with a BOLD mindset—We Build Championship Teams, we're Obsessed with Fans, we embrace a Limitless Entrepreneurial Spirit, and we approach every challenge with a Determined & Relentless Mindset. If you're ready to contribute to a dynamic, fast-paced environment that thrives on collaboration and growth, we want you to be part of our team. By submitting your application, you agree to our terms of service and acknowledge you have read our [Candidate Privacy Policy.](https://static1.squarespace.com/static/5ff494b9931735466ce28d5b/t/69de53bde2c02c25e9c38758/1776178110037/Candidate+Privacy+Policy+April+2026.pdf) *Fanatics will never ask candidates for money, banking information, or other sensitive personal information as part of the interview process. If you receive a suspicious message claiming to be from Fanatics recruiting, please do not respond and report it*[*here*](mailto:recruiting-fraud@fanaticsinc.com)*.*

hatch I.T. is partnering with Expression to find a **Junior Test Engineer (VOR)**. See details below: **About The Role:** Expression is seeking a **Junior Test Engineer** to help improve the quality, reliability, and usability of VOR, their platform for connecting data, AI agents, and workflows to support complex operational needs. You will work alongside developers, product owners, and experienced engineers to test web applications, APIs, data integrations, and AI-enabled workflows. You will help investigate unexpected behavior, identify gaps in the user experience, and build repeatable ways to verify that the product works. They are looking for someone who asks good questions, enjoys figuring out how systems behave, and is eager to use AI and automation in their work. Test plans provide a starting point; curiosity and sound judgment help uncover the problems they miss. You do not need to arrive as an automation expert, but you should want to learn how to turn repetitive testing into reliable automated checks. **Location and Clearance:** - **Clearance:** Eligibility to obtain a clearance is required. - **Location:** Hybrid or Remote. Our HQ is located at the heart of Washington, DC. If you are local you are welcome to use our office and all the perks that it offers. **About the Company:** Founded in 1997 and headquartered in Washington DC, Expression provides data fusion, data analytics, software engineering, information technology, and electromagnetic spectrum management solutions to the U.S. Department of Defense, Department of State, and national security community. Expression’s “Perpetual Innovation” culture focuses on creating immediate and sustainable value for their clients via agile delivery of tailored solutions built through constant engagement with their clients. Expression was ranked #1 on the Washington Technology 2018's Fast 50 list of fastest growing small business Government contractors and a Top 20 Big Data Solutions Provider by CIO Review. ### Responsibilities: - Test VOR’s web interfaces, APIs, and workflows, including how users connect data sources, configure tools and agents, and review workflow results. - Explore real user scenarios, edge cases, and failure conditions to find issues beyond documented acceptance criteria. - Work with developers and product owners to clarify expected behavior and identify quality risks early. - Document defects with clear reproduction steps, expected and actual results, and useful evidence such as screenshots, logs, or API responses. - Use approved AI tools to help explore test scenarios, generate test data, draft automation, and investigate failures. Review and verify their output. - Build and maintain automated tests with guidance from experienced engineers, prioritizing repeatable checks that protect important user journeys. - Help evaluate AI-enabled features for grounded responses, useful citations, appropriate tool behavior, and consistent handling of uncertainty. - Test permissions, data boundaries, approval steps, and error recovery to help ensure workflows behave appropriately. - Investigate failed tests, distinguish product defects from test or environment issues, and verify fixes. - Contribute clear testing evidence and communicate remaining risks to support release decisions. ### Qualifications: - Bachelor's degree in computer science or related fields and 1 year of professional experience. - 2+ years of foundational experience with software testing or development through employment, internships, coursework, or personal projects. - Basic understanding of functional, regression, and exploratory testing. - Ability to translate a user goal or requirement into meaningful test scenarios, including unexpected inputs and failure cases. - Willingness to learn scripting and test automation using languages such as Python or JavaScript/TypeScript. - Openness to using AI tools thoughtfully, checking their work, and improving your approach through experimentation. - Strong analytical skills and the persistence to investigate an issue when the cause is unclear. - Ability to explain findings clearly and collaborate constructively with others. ### Preferred Qualifications: - Exposure to browser automation tools such as Playwright, Cypress, or Selenium. - Experience testing APIs with tools such as Postman, curl, or automated test frameworks. - Familiarity with Git, CI/CD pipelines, and reading application logs. - Basic knowledge of SQL, data validation, or testing data ingestion and retrieval. - Experience using AI coding assistants or testing applications that incorporate language models. - Exposure to containers, cloud environments, or enterprise software. - Eligibility to obtain a U.S. security clearance.

description: # About MSF USA | Doctors Without Borders Doctors Without Borders/Médecins Sans Frontières (MSF) is an independent international organization that provides medical care to the people who need it most. The organization cares for people affected by conflict, disease outbreaks, disasters, and social exclusion in more than 70 countries. MSF offers medical humanitarian assistance solely based on need, regardless of race, ethnicity, religion, or politics. Our international project teams include medical, logistical, and administrative staff, most of them hired locally and working with their own communities. Our actions are guided by medical ethics and the principles of independence, impartiality, and neutrality. We also bear witness and speak out about the experiences of our colleagues and patients. MSF USA is one of 24 sections supporting the global movement, primarily through staff recruitment, fundraising, advocacy, and communications. We welcome candidates who bring a wide variety of backgrounds and experiences to join us in working toward MSF’s social mission. **ROLE OVERVIEW** We are seeking a highly motivated and detail-oriented intern to assist in various aspects of audiovisual (A/V) support and multimedia content production within the Communications department of our organization. This role offers a hands-on opportunity to gain more experience in content production, planning, and visual storytelling within a dynamic and creative environment. The intern will be involved in supporting the production of a video podcast and editing a steady stream of video content, assisting with other elements of day-to-day content production, A/V room organization, analytics reporting, and multimedia event support. The intern will work closely with an experienced Multimedia team and could have the opportunity to participate in high- profile events and projects. Candidates must have demonstrable experience shooting and editing video in Adobe Premiere and must submit a portfolio link consisting of 3 –5 videos with your application. Please indicate what work you did on each piece, and when each was created. **DEPARTMENT ACCOUNTABILITIES** The Communications Department is responsible for developing a coherent voice and delivering clear public messages to inform both US and international audiences of MSF, its field activities and the humanitarian principles that underpin them; to raise awareness about the plight of the populations we serve; to promote public communication aimed at exposing and describing the field reality, including dilemmas and challenges; and to garner public understanding for our advocacy messages related to field operational concerns and the Access Campaign, via the media, print and digital channels, public awareness and advocacy campaigns, conferences, etc. **External Communications** Develop and distribute external communications products across multiple channels to bear witness to humanitarian needs, speak out with patients and communities, engage with audiences, and achieve strategic objectives. **Public Engagement & Advocacy** Identify significant medical humanitarian issues and execute integrated communications plans to increase public awareness, audience engagement, and support for advocacy priorities. **Brand Positioning** Develop and contribute toward brand strategy, brand positioning, and tactics to increase brand visibility. **Content Creation** Develop and support the production of creative and engaging external communications across audiences and channels, including for the website, social media, and live events. **Advance Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion** Promote DEI principles across all communications products and channels. **ROLE SPECIFIC OUTCOMES** The video intern will assist in all phases of the creation and promotion of MSF video content. This is a hands-on position offering the opportunity to actively contribute to the tools through which MSF communicates its messages. The ideal candidate will provide essential support to new and ongoing projects. - Passionate about MSF-USA’s social mission to provide medical humanitarian aid. - Have proven technical ability in videography and video editing. - Interested in international humanitarian affairs and medical issues - Interested in documentary film, journalism, non-profit communications, and/or international affairs. - Committed to upholding diversity, equity, and inclusion - Highly creative and organized **Content Creation** Support creation and dissemination of engaging audiovisual content about MSF’s medical humanitarian work for all channels, including web, social media, and live events. **External Communications** Contribute toward implementation of multimedia plans for significant aspects of the organization's external communications, with guidance from the Director of Communications. **Public Engagement Execution** Deliver specified multimedia outputs and outcomes to inform and engage audiences and provide others with professional support while working within established communications systems. **Public Engagement Planning** Contribute to research and development of tactical social media campaigns and public engagement activities using audiovisual elements. **Data & Analytics** Support tracking video performance on social media, identifying trends, adapting to algorithm changes, and making recommendations based on data. **COMPLEXITY AND PROBLEM-SOLVING SKILLS** - Will assist with producing and editing a variety of video projects including editing short form videos for use on social media, web, etc. - Research and use of video from MSF’s international photo and video database. - Regular reporting on video performance metrics using YouTube’s Insights. - Adding simple on-screen text to videos, proofreading graphics and post-copy - Learning search engine optimization (SEO) principles and best practices and implementing them. - Creating or assisting in the creation of simple graphics. - Setting up and assisting with film production on site. - Supporting translation processes. Organization and upkeep of A/V equipment, inventory lists, and digital files. - Researching new equipment, video workflows, or solutions as needed to support the work of the video team. - Other tasks as assigned **BEHAVIORAL COMPETENCIES** *THOUGHT: How MSF USA staff understand the organization, manage complexity, and contribute by creating the new and different.* **People Focus** Builds strong relationships and delivers solutions geared to aiding others. Solicits feedback and data; conveys a clear understanding of the level of service the team is providing; takes action when standards are not met by team; aligns processes with organizational needs. **Manages Complexity** Makes sense of complex, high quantity, and sometimes contradictory information to effectively solve problems. Consistently looks at complex issues from many angles; obtains a rich and deep understanding; swiftly cuts to the core issue; skillfully separates root causes from symptoms. **Global Perspective** Takes a broad view when approaching issues, using a global lens. Shows global thinking at work; adjusts organizational practices to meet the unique needs of different regions or countries. Uses a broad perspective when addressing issues and challenges. **Cultivates Innovation** Creates new and better ways for the organization to be successful. Approaches professional work in unique or innovative ways. Offers original ideas. Appreciates others' creative ideas and solutions and provides helpful input to enhance them. *RESULTS: MSF USA staff achieve results by cultivating a forward-thinking environment that produces solutions for changing stakeholder needs.* **Drives Results** Consistently achieves results, even under tough circumstances. Regularly pushes self to achieve outstanding outcomes; consistently establishes bold goals for own performance; is passionate about excellent results and significant contributions. Shows great tenacity to complete goals/initiatives in a timely way. *PEOPLE: MSF USA staff understand their impact on others through collaboration and inclusion of different perspectives to achieve common goals.* **Collaborates** Builds partnerships and works collaboratively with others to meet shared objectives. Readily involves others to accomplish goals; stays in touch and shares information; discourages "us versus them" thinking; shows appreciation for others' ideas and input. **Values Differences** Recognizes the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization. Confronts stereotyping and offensive comments promptly. Consistently behaves with great sensitivity toward differences in cultural norms, expectations, and ways of communicating. **Communicates Effectively** Develops and delivers multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences. Listens attentively and takes an interest. Keeps others well informed; conveys information clearly, concisely, and professionally when speaking or writing. *SELF: MSF USA staff demonstrate self-awareness by having an open mindset and by continuously seeking opportunities to learn, grow, and improve.* **Instills Trust** Gains the confidence and trust of others through honesty, integrity, and authenticity. Models honesty and authenticity and encourages others to be up front with one another. Demonstrates reliability and places a strong emphasis on the team meeting its commitments. Fairly represents others' positions. **Manages Ambiguity** Operates effectively, even when things are not certain or the way forward is not clear. Responds effectively to unclear situations, seeks to resolve ambiguity and make progress. Seeks guidance on how to adapt to changes, responds with appropriate composure and effectiveness. **Situational Adaptability** Adapts approach and demeanor in real time to match the shifting demands of different situations. Serves as an example of adaptability and provides guidance and support to help others adapt to new situations. Considers the needs of clients, constituents, and the organization; shifts priorities appropriately. **TECHNICAL COMPETENCIES** **Plans and Aligns** Planning and prioritizing work to meet commitments aligned with MSF-USA goals. **Financial Acumen** Interprets and applies understanding of key financial indicators to make better business decisions. **Tech Savvy** Anticipating and adopting innovations in organizational digital and technology applications . **Data Collection and Analysis** The ability and skill to determine and analyze trends from data that is collected to assist in compiling reports that will help in decision-making. **Project Management Skills** The ability and skill to plan and manage small project work assignments within desired cost, time and quality parameters. **Presentation and Written Communication Skills** Adapts approach and demeanor in real time to match the shifting demands of different situations. Serves as an example of adaptability and provides guidance and support to help others adapt to new situations. Considers the needs of clients, constituents, and the organization; shifts priorities appropriately. **SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITY** None **DESIRED QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE** At a minimum the Job Holder should possess: - Demonstrable experience shooting and editing video. You must submit a portfolio link consisting of 3 – 5 videos. Please indicate what work you did on each piece, and when each was created. - High level of proficiency with Premiere Pro. Working knowledge of Photoshop and Audition. Proficiency in After Effects and Illustrator is a plus. - Familiarity editing on a PC or Mac laptop, to be provided by MSF. - Basic understanding of A/V equipment and experience with studio recording, including camera and audio setup. - Strong organizational skills and attention to detail. - Experience reporting social media or web analytics is a plus. - Proficiency in a second language is a plus. Preference for Spanish, French, or Arabic. **TRAVEL REQUIREMENTS** No travel is required for this position. **DAYS/HOURS PER WEEK** Preferred: availability to work 4 days per week, including Tuesdays and Wednesdays onsite. **DURATION** 3 Months with the possibility of an extension **ESTIMATED START DATE** January 2027 **COMPENSATION** $18.40/hour **Location** New York, NY (On-site or Hybrid) This role is based in our New York office, where most of the team and operational infrastructure are located. Due to current staffing and budget constraints, we’re unable to support this position in our DC or California offices. **Equal Opportunity and Accommodations Statement:** MSF-USA is dedicated to creating a diverse, impartial, and inclusive workforce. We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate based on gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, race, religion, age, national origin, disability, marital status, pregnancy status, veteran status, genetic information, or any other differences as per applicable laws. We seek a diversity of experience and skills for our workplace and encourage people from all backgrounds to apply to our openings. We also provide reasonable accommodations for individuals with disabilities or religious beliefs and practices. If you require accommodations during the application process, please contact us at . We strongly encourage individuals from underrepresented communities in the Humanitarian Aid sector to apply. **Safeguarding Statement:** All Employees and Representatives of MSF USA have a duty to treat the individuals, families, and communities with whom we interact and serve with dignity and respect, and to ensure their safety and protection. We are committed to fostering a workplace and organizational culture that is safe, inclusive, and free from harassment, abuse, exploitation, and discrimination. This commitment is supported by policies and procedures that promote an environment where misconduct and abuse are not tolerated. role: 2027 Summer Internship - Sector Analyst, Proprietary Research
description: **A Career with Point72’s Market Intelligence Team** On our proprietary research team—Market Intelligence—you’ll support Data Research team members as they work with our investment professionals and Compliance team to uncover insights about companies, industries, and the broader economy through deep fundamental research and applying data science and engineering techniques to alternative data sets. You’ll work alongside a talented team with diverse skills, backgrounds, and perspectives. Our industry researchers, product managers, and data scientists and engineers work together to build compliant research products that answer the questions our investment professionals care about most. We look for other bright, motivated, and collaborative people to join our team and grow with us. **About the Sector Analyst Internship** As a sector analyst, you will provide industry context and business fundamentals to our team of data scientists and engineers and support the team that delivers tailored and synthesized insights to our investment professionals. You should be curious about global industry trends, business models, and supply chains, and enjoy developing deep sector expertise. You should excel at distilling clear takeaways from complex qualitative and quantitative information—including alternative data—and be energized by an experiment-driven research approach, shifting priorities, and close collaboration across investment, research, and compliance teams. role: Systems Intern - Validation, Software, Design, Architecture & Packaging (USA)
location: Austin, Texas, United States; Santa Clara, California, United States
description: Tenstorrent is leading the industry on cutting-edge AI technology, revolutionizing performance expectations, ease of use, and cost efficiency. With AI redefining the computing paradigm, solutions must evolve to unify innovations in software models, compilers, platforms, networking, and semiconductors. Our diverse team of technologists have developed a high performance RISC-V CPU from scratch, and share a passion for AI and a deep desire to build the best AI platform possible. We value collaboration, curiosity, and a commitment to solving hard problems. We are growing our team and looking for contributors of all seniorities. **Overview:** A chip isn't a product until it's a working system. These teams cover both ends of that: getting silicon to boot and validate correctly,building the board, power, mechanical, thermal, packaging and IO around it. You submit one application, you have one recruiter screen - then we match you to the specific team below and location that fits best. - **Systems & Silicon Validation:** Post-silicon testing of physical chips and integrated systems to ensure they meet all functional, electrical, and performance specs. - **System Software:** Development of foundational software, including firmware, drivers, and operating systems, that directly controls and interfaces with hardware. - **System Design:** The process of defining, integrating, and mapping out hardware components such as PCBs, software modules, and interfaces into a complete product blueprint. - **System Architecture:** Define the high-level structural framework, interfaces, and data-flow pathways between the CPU, memory, and peripherals. - **Packaging:** A package is what is placed between the silicon and the board; and its design requires detailed electrical, electromagnetic, and mechanical simulations and analysis. This role is on-site, based out of Austin, TX or Santa Clara, CA. **Who You Are** - Currently pursuing a BS, MS, or PhD in EE, Computer Engineering, Computer Science or Mechanical Engineering - Coursework or projects in embedded systems, microwave and signal integrity, board-level design, or thermal/mechanical engineering using low-level programming (C/C++, Python) or hardware design and/or simulation tools (e.g., CAD, FEA, Verilog). - Problem solver with strong foundational knowledge in one of these areas: electrical engineering, digital logic, computer architecture, or thermal/mechanical. - Curious learner who is passionate about the intersection of software, silicon architecture, and the physical constraints of chip packaging and printed circuit boards (PCBs). **What We Need** - **Systems & Silicon Validation:** Assist in post-silicon testing of physical microchips under real-world workloads to ensure they meet all functional, electrical, and performance specifications. - **System Software:** Contribute to developing foundational software—including firmware, drivers, and operating systems—that directly controls and interfaces with the semiconductor hardware. - **System Design & Architecture:** Help map out, define, and evaluate high-level structural frameworks, optimizing the power delivery and high-speed performance benchmarks of both the silicon components and the underlying PCBs. - **Semiconductor Packaging & Mechanical Design:** Design and layout, Electromagnetic (signal integrity and power integrity), mechanical design, and stress analysis **What You Will Learn** - Hands-on silicon experience using industry-standard lab equipment to bridge the gap between theoretical hardware design, physical packaging layouts, and real-world chips. - Low-level software development by writing production-grade firmware, device drivers, and diagnostic tools that run directly on bare metal. - Mechanical & thermal engineering for electronics by learning how structural stress, heat dissipation, thermal expansion, and mechanical shock affect the structural integrity and performance of PCBs and packages. - Cross-functional collaboration working alongside world-class architects, mechanical designers, package engineers, and software teams to understand how complex, large-scale chip ecosystems are built from scratch. **USA Hiring Timelines** This internship opportunity is available throughout our 3 terms with the following corresponding recruitment cycles: - role: Apprenticeships in Equipment Maintenance, Automation, Setup & Process Technicians
description: Suncast Corporation is the leading US-based designer, manufacturer, and distributor of high-quality resin products for the home and industrial markets. A privately held company headquartered in Western Chicago, Illinois, Suncast prides itself on 35 years of innovation and sustainability across a wide range of product categories with materials proudly sourced in the USA. Everything we do is supported by the strength and ingenuity of American workers and we are committed to helping families across the country make the most of their unique spaces. We utilize state-of-the-art machinery and innovative manufacturing techniques to consistently engineer products of the highest possible quality. Suncast is the market leader in the manufacture of plastic injection and blow molded home and garden items, which are sold by large retailers worldwide. To keep pace with our continued growth and expansion, Suncast Corporation has established an apprenticeship program to train and develop our future technicians in all manufacturing areas, such as Equipment Maintenance, Automation, Setup and Process. Establish a challenging, rewarding, lifetime career in manufacturing! The Apprentice is responsible for participating in a structured apprenticeship program that combines full-time employment, hands-on training, mentorship, and classroom instruction. Apprentices will develop technical skills in Metals, Automation, Setup, Equipment Maintenance, or Process while working alongside experienced professionals. The program is designed to prepare individuals for a successful long-term career in manufacturing through practical experience, technical education, and continuous skill development. About Orlando City SC & Orlando Pride: In November 2013, Orlando City Soccer Club was awarded a Major League Soccer (MLS) franchise, becoming the league’s 21st franchise. The team began play in March 2015, with 62,510 fans packing the then-Orlando Citrus Bowl for the Club’s MLS debut. The Lions have reached the postseason in five-consecutive seasons (2020-24), qualified for the Concacaf Champions Cup (formerly Concacaf Champions League) in both 2023 and 2024, and reached their first final in 2020 during the MLS is Back Tournament. In 2022, Orlando City won its first championship of its MLS era, lifting the Lamar Hunt U.S. Open Cup trophy, which also marked the first championship by any professional team in the City Beautiful. Prior to its time in MLS, Orlando City boasted a decorated history in the United Soccer League, winning the league’s championship in both the 2011 and 2013 seasons. In October 2015, the Orlando Pride was announced as the 10th team in the National Women’s Soccer League (NWSL), bringing professional women’s soccer to the state of Florida for the first time. The team began play in April 2016, setting a then-league single-game attendance record in its first-ever home game, with 23,403 fans witnessing the Club’s first win. The Pride feature a star-studded roster of domestic and international talent and, in 2024, brought the first professional major league title to the city of Orlando, with the Club winning the NWSL Championship. The season saw the Pride complete the double, winning both the Championship and the NWSL Shield as the best team in the regular season, capping off a historic campaign that set numerous league records. Former Orlando City defender Seb Hines serves as the team’s head coach, not only the first Black head coach in the league, but also the first to win both the Championship and the NWSL Shield, and the 2024 NWSL Coach of the Year. In 2017, both teams moved into its privately-owned, soccer-specific venue – Inter&Co Stadium – located in the heart of downtown Orlando. In July 2021, the Club – which includes Orlando City SC, the Orlando Pride, Orlando City B (MLS NEXT Pro) and Inter&Co Stadium – was purchased by the Wilf Family, who also own the Minnesota Vikings of the National Football League. You'll take ownership early, work closely with teams to solve real-world challenges, and see the direct results of your decisions as they reach customers every day. Here, the impact of what you build isn't abstract, it's visible, immediate, and meaningful — keeping one of the world's most complex operations moving forward. This is where your journey takes shape through action, responsibility, and the opportunity to grow in many directions. Amazon North American Customer Fulfillment (NACF) is a central part of Amazon and at the heart of our supply chain processes. The Central Flow team focuses on operational execution, risk mitigation, and best practices to deliver for our customers. Are you interested in working on a fast-paced team that pioneers ways to delight customers? Do you have a passion for deep diving data and crunching numbers? Central Flow Leads are responsible for monitoring and managing these workflow functions from a centralized location in Tempe, Arizona or Nashville, Tennessee. Amazon is looking for college students with high-potential. As you join our team, you will have an opportunity to work with stakeholders across North America and develop a collaborative leadership style, while utilizing the tools and processes that have helped create the most customer-centric company on Earth. Flow leads are empowered to use data to drive decisions that can positively impact their teams and customers. Central Flow Interns will bring Amazon’s customer obsession to life in an execution focused environment. You will work on a team of engaged flow leaders to deliver a best-in-class fulfillment experience for customers and stakeholders. You will play a vital role in maintaining a vibrant team culture based on customer obsession, trust, respect, continuous learning, safety, and fun. Central Flow Leads are natural leaders who are comfortable with change and are always looking for ways to improve their operation through data-driven decision making. Central Flow Leads demonstrate a strong work ethic, excellent ownership, the ability to meet deadlines, a willingness to learn new things, and a commitment to the customer and employee experience. This position interacts with stakeholders across the US and Canada and will be located in the Central Flow center of excellence in Tempe, Arizona or Nashville, TN. • Competitive pay and relocation (if qualified) Compensation: Hourly base pay ($23.32- $25.91 range - location based), sign on payments, and restricted stock units. A day in the life As a Central Flow Lead, you will have the opportunity to learn how to coach and develop leaders within an Amazon Fulfillment Center. You will ensure that the Amazon sites you support have all the tools needed to succeed for any task during a shift. Through performing daily syncs, hourly audits, and more, you will engage with leaders on the frontline, modeling behaviors of success and jumping in to provide guidance or share your experience or develop these leaders.

The focus of your role will be to learn the skills and abilities to ensure safety regulations and policies are adhered to, assist in the installation, maintenance, and repair of the automated packaging and distribution equipment, ensure preventative maintenance is conducted on time to a high standard, and provide high levels of equipment availability through continuous improvement. Entry-Level Traveling Project Manager GMEA LLC | Full-Time | Nationwide Travel Required $65,000–$75,000 Annually | No Experience Required | Bachelor’s Degree Required | Paid Training About the Position Start your career helping manage large-scale construction projects across the United States — no previous experience required! GMEA LLC is a rapidly growing nationwide commercial and industrial electrical contractor seeking motivated, organized, and ambitious college graduates to join our team as Entry-Level Traveling Project Managers. This is an exciting opportunity to earn a competitive salary, travel throughout the country, gain hands-on experience on major construction projects, and develop valuable leadership and management skills early in your career. No previous construction, electrical, or project management experience is required. We provide the training, mentorship, and support necessary to succeed. We’re looking for individuals who are dependable, detail-oriented, eager to learn, and comfortable taking responsibility. Unlike traditional office positions, this role puts you directly in the field, working alongside experienced construction professionals, interacting with customers, and helping oversee projects from start to finish. This is an excellent opportunity for a recent college graduate who enjoys traveling, working with people, solving problems, and wants to build a long-term career in project management. Compensation & Benefits This position offers a competitive starting salary of $65,000–$75,000 annually , based on qualifications, with opportunities for performance-based bonuses and salary increases as experience and responsibilities grow. GMEA offers: Company-paid business travel, including flights, accommodations, and transportation. Daily meal per diem while traveling, in accordance with company policy. Company-paid health, dental, and vision insurance. Paid time off. 401(k) retirement plan. Paid training and mentorship from experienced construction professionals. Opportunities for career advancement into senior project management and operations leadership positions. We believe in rewarding employees who demonstrate initiative, develop their skills, and take on increasing responsibility. Travel & Work Schedule Requirements — Please Read Carefully Extensive nationwide travel is a mandatory requirement of this position. Must be willing and able to travel frequently by air throughout the United States. Project assignments may last several weeks to multiple months. Must be comfortable spending extended periods away from home. Must be physically present onsite each day that assigned construction activities are taking place, unless otherwise directed by management. Must be comfortable working in active construction environments, including warehouses, manufacturing facilities, and other commercial and industrial settings. Work schedules are determined by project needs and construction activities. Hours may exceed 40 per week and may include early mornings, evenings, or weekends. GMEA provides company-paid travel accommodations and opportunities for trips home in accordance with company travel policies. This is a field-based position, not a remote, hybrid, or traditional office role. Applicants must be genuinely interested in extensive travel and spending the majority of their working time at active construction sites. What a Typical Day Looks Like As an Entry-Level Project Manager, you’ll spend most of your day at an active construction site, helping ensure work progresses safely, efficiently, and according to plan. Your day might include: Walking the project with field supervisors to review installation progress. Taking photos and preparing daily reports for management. Attending coordination meetings with customers, general contractors, and other project stakeholders. Reviewing project schedules and identifying potential delays or concerns. Checking that employees have the materials, tools, and equipment needed to complete their work. Conducting routine safety walks and verifying proper use of personal protective equipment (PPE). Ensuring tools, materials, and equipment are properly organized, stored, and secured. Communicating project updates, questions, and concerns to company leadership. You’ll work closely with experienced electricians, field supervisors, and project managers who will help you understand the construction process. You will not be expected to know how to manage a construction project on your first day. We will teach you the technical aspects of the job. Your responsibility is to show up prepared, stay organized, communicate clearly, follow established procedures, and be willing to learn. Key Responsibilities Project Oversight & Reporting Monitor daily installation progress and help ensure work follows established project schedules, installation plans, and management instructions. Document construction progress through photographs, daily reports, and regular project updates. Identify potential delays, installation concerns, and missing materials, and communicate them promptly to management. Customer & Team Communication Attend onsite meetings with customers, general contractors, and project stakeholders. Communicate professionally with customers, field supervisors, electricians, and company leadership. Coordinate with field personnel to track progress, address concerns, and support project execution. Field Safety & Site Organization Spend significant time in the field observing installations and conducting routine site walks. Monitor compliance with company safety procedures, site requirements, and proper PPE usage, escalating concerns to the appropriate supervisor. Help ensure company tools, materials, and equipment are properly tracked, stored, secured, and maintained. Monitor material deliveries, identify shortages, and help maintain an organized and professional jobsite. Minimum Qualifications Bachelor’s degree required. Bachelor’s degree must be fully completed at the time of application. Current students who have not yet graduated are not eligible. No previous construction, electrical, or project management experience required. Must be willing and able to travel extensively throughout the United States, including assignments lasting several weeks or months. Must be available to work onsite daily during assigned construction activities, including occasional evenings and weekends as required. Strong communication, organizational, and time-management skills. Comfortable using computers, smartphones, and basic business software. Ability to follow instructions, maintain accurate documentation, and communicate issues promptly. Comfortable spending significant time standing, walking, and working in active construction environments. Dependable, self-motivated, detail-oriented, and eager to learn. Candidates with degrees in business, engineering, construction management, operations, supply chain management, or related fields are encouraged to apply. However, all bachelor’s degree majors will be considered. Who We’re Looking For We’re not looking for someone who already knows how to manage electrical construction projects. We’re looking for someone with the right attitude, work ethic, and willingness to learn. The ideal candidate: Enjoys traveling and experiencing new places. GMEA LLC | Full-Time | Nationwide Travel Required $65,000–$75,000 Annually | No Experience Required | Bachelor’s Degree Required | Paid Training About the Position Start your career helping manage large-scale construction projects across the United States — no previous experience required! GMEA LLC is a rapidly growing nationwide commercial and industrial electrical contractor seeking motivated, organized, and ambitious college graduates to join our team as Entry-Level Traveling Project Managers. This is an exciting opportunity to earn a competitive salary, travel throughout the country, gain hands-on experience on major construction projects, and develop valuable leadership and management skills early in your career. No previous construction, electrical, or project management experience is required. We provide the training, mentorship, and support necessary to succeed. We’re looking for individuals who are dependable, detail-oriented, eager to learn, and comfortable taking responsibility. Unlike traditional office positions, this role puts you directly in the field, working alongside experienced construction professionals, interacting with customers, and helping oversee projects from start to finish. This is an excellent opportunity for a recent college graduate who enjoys traveling, working with people, solving problems, and wants to build a long-term career in project management. Compensation & Benefits This position offers a competitive starting salary of $65,000–$75,000 annually , based on qualifications, with opportunities for performance-based bonuses and salary increases as experience and responsibilities grow. GMEA offers: Company-paid business travel, including flights, accommodations, and transportation. Daily meal per diem while traveling, in accordance with company policy. Company-paid health, dental, and vision insurance. Paid time off. 401(k) retirement plan. Paid training and mentorship from experienced construction professionals. Opportunities for career advancement into senior project management and operations leadership positions. We believe in rewarding employees who demonstrate initiative, develop their skills, and take on increasing responsibility. Travel & Work Schedule Requirements — Please Read Carefully Extensive nationwide travel is a mandatory requirement of this position. Must be willing and able to travel frequently by air throughout the United States. Project assignments may last several weeks to multiple months. Must be comfortable spending extended periods away from home. Must be physically present onsite each day that assigned construction activities are taking place, unless otherwise directed by management. Must be comfortable working in active construction environments, including warehouses, manufacturing facilities, and other commercial and industrial settings. Work schedules are determined by project needs and construction activities. Hours may exceed 40 per week and may include early mornings, evenings, or weekends. GMEA provides company-paid travel accommodations and opportunities for trips home in accordance with company travel policies. This is a field-based position, not a remote, hybrid, or traditional office role. Applicants must be genuinely interested in extensive travel and spending the majority of their working time at active construction sites. What a Typical Day Looks Like As an Entry-Level Project Manager, you’ll spend most of your day at an active construction site, helping ensure work progresses safely, efficiently, and according to plan. Your day might include: Walking the project with field supervisors to review installation progress. Taking photos and preparing daily reports for management. Attending coordination meetings with customers, general contractors, and other project stakeholders. Reviewing project schedules and identifying potential delays or concerns. Checking that employees have the materials, tools, and equipment needed to complete their work. Conducting routine safety walks and verifying proper use of personal protective equipment (PPE). Ensuring tools, materials, and equipment are properly organized, stored, and secured. Communicating project updates, questions, and concerns to company leadership. You’ll work closely with experienced electricians, field supervisors, and project managers who will help you understand the construction process. You will not be expected to know how to manage a construction project on your first day. We will teach you the technical aspects of the job. Your responsibility is to show up prepared, stay organized, communicate clearly, follow established procedures, and be willing to learn. Key Responsibilities Project Oversight & Reporting Monitor daily installation progress and help ensure work follows established project schedules, installation plans, and management instructions. Document construction progress through photographs, daily reports, and regular project updates. Identify potential delays, installation concerns, and missing materials, and communicate them promptly to management. Customer & Team Communication Attend onsite meetings with customers, general contractors, and project stakeholders. Communicate professionally with customers, field supervisors, electricians, and company leadership. Coordinate with field personnel to track progress, address concerns, and support project execution. Field Safety & Site Organization Spend significant time in the field observing installations and conducting routine site walks. Monitor compliance with company safety procedures, site requirements, and proper PPE usage, escalating concerns to the appropriate supervisor. Help ensure company tools, materials, and equipment are properly tracked, stored, secured, and maintained. Monitor material deliveries, identify shortages, and help maintain an organized and professional jobsite. Minimum Qualifications Bachelor’s degree required. Bachelor’s degree must be fully completed at the time of application. Current students who have not yet graduated are not eligible. No previous construction, electrical, or project management experience required. Must be willing and able to travel extensively throughout the United States, including assignments lasting several weeks or months. Must be available to work onsite daily during assigned construction activities, including occasional evenings and weekends as required. Strong communication, organizational, and time-management skills. Comfortable using computers, smartphones, and basic business software. Ability to follow instructions, maintain accurate documentation, and communicate issues promptly. Comfortable spending significant time standing, walking, and working in active construction environments. Dependable, self-motivated, detail-oriented, and eager to learn. Candidates with degrees in business, engineering, construction management, operations, supply chain management, or related fields are encouraged to apply. However, all bachelor’s degree majors will be considered. Who We’re Looking For We’re not looking for someone who already knows how to manage electrical construction projects. We’re looking for someone with the right attitude, work ethic, and willingness to learn. The ideal candidate: Enjoys traveling and experiencing new places. Prefers an active work environment over sitting behind a desk all day. Is organized, observant, and pays attention to details. Enjoys interacting with people and building professional relationships. New Project Managers receive hands-on training, guidance, and mentorship from experienced construction professionals while gradually taking on additional responsibilities. As you develop your skills, you’ll have opportunities to manage larger projects, lead teams, build customer relationships, and advance into senior project management or operations leadership positions. We’re looking for individuals who want to grow alongside our company and become valuable members of our long-term leadership team. If you’ve completed your bachelor’s degree, are excited about extensive nationwide travel, and want to build a rewarding career in project management, we encourage you to apply!

Location: Kohler, WI This is a seasonal 12-month Intern/Trainee program for the 2027 season, working weekdays and weekends. Shifts vary between 6:00 a.m. and 9:30 p.m.. Opportunity The Spa Receptionist Intern/Trainee program offers a unique opportunity to gain exposure to multiple areas of spa operations while developing guest service, leadership, and hospitality management skills. Participants will begin their training at the Spa Front Desk and rotate through several departments, including Spa Attendant, Spa Café Server, and Spa Coordinator functions, gaining a well-rounded understanding of how a Forbes Five-Star spa operation delivers exceptional guest experiences. This program is designed for participants who are either currently enrolled in post-secondary education outside the United States (Interns) or who have completed their education and/or have relevant professional experience (Trainees). The program focuses on structured training, professional development, and cultural exchange while providing hands-on experience in luxury hospitality environments. As a member of the Kohler Waters Spa team, you will learn how guest service, operations, scheduling, retail, food and beverage, and leadership teams work together to create memorable experiences for guests. Through hands-on training, shadowing opportunities, and progressive responsibility, participants will build the knowledge and skills needed for future hospitality leadership roles. The Spa Receptionist is an integral part of the Spa team whose main objective is to ensure guests have a smooth arrival, departure, and overall relaxing experience while visiting the spa. In this training program, participants will develop expertise in front desk operations while gaining exposure to multiple spa departments and leadership functions. Throughout the program, participants will: Welcome guests and create a warm, professional, and luxury spa experience Schedule, modify, and manage spa reservations and guest itineraries Learn and utilize ResortSuite and other guest management systems Assist guests with spa services, treatments, amenities, and retail recommendations Process payments, memberships, packages, gift cards, and billing transactions Support retail sales, merchandising, and product knowledge initiatives Coordinate guest experiences with spa technicians, attendants, café staff, and leadership teams Learn service recovery techniques and how to professionally resolve guest concerns Rotate through Spa Attendant responsibilities to learn facility operations, guest flow, cleanliness standards, and service delivery Gain experience supporting Spa Café operations, including guest engagement and wellness-focused food and beverage service Shadow Spa Coordinators and leadership team members to learn scheduling, staffing, operational decision-making, guest flow management, and event coordination Participate in cross-department collaboration and communication to better understand luxury spa operations Develop leadership, communication, and problem-solving skills through structured training and mentorship opportunities Support the cleanliness and maintenance of Kohler Waters Spa facilities, amenities, and guest areas The program combines classroom-style learning, shadowing, hands-on training, operational projects, and leadership exposure to provide a comprehensive understanding of spa operations and hospitality management.

This includes partnering on course development (aligning objectives, materials, and assessments), creating dynamic instructional media (videos, infographics, and interactive resources), maintaining established courses with updates and troubleshooting, and receiving just-in-time assistance for targeted needs Serving as an Adjunct Lecturer provides an outstanding opportunity to educate and mentor students as well as to form a rewarding professional relationship with Columbia University’s world-class faculty. description: Columbia University School of Professional Studies (SPS) seeks candidates for the role of Adjunct Lecturer to teach Project Planning, Scheduling, and Control , a graduate-level course in the M.S. in Project Management program. This course provides a comprehensive foundation in planning, scheduling, and controlling projects across diverse industries. Students will learn the principles, methods, and quantitative tools used to develop work breakdown structures, establish project baselines, and apply critical path method (CPM) analysis to identify, sequence, and manage project activities.
